entities.name: Gyokko
entities.description:
Before becoming a demon, he was a human by the name of |Managi}}.

Gyokko had a bizarre and grotesque physiology, taking on the form of a pale white, abstracted humanoid figure with an armless, muscular upper torso. His figure resembled a djinn surfacing from a white porcelain vase, which was decorated with branches of green leaves along with red, yellow and purple flowers. His midsection was a red-violet color while his lower-half was black. He had multiple underdeveloped and infant-like hands with red fingernails; four on his head that replaced his ears, and several on his body and tail, which he could retract at will. He also possessed thin fins on the top and back of his head in place of his hair; these were of a blended hue of purple and blue-violet, as well as shaped in the style of cornrows and a ponytail.

Gyokko’s face had a deeply distorted appearance alongside his sharp nose. His large, green-lipped mouths were located where one’s eye sockets normally would be, displaying his hyper-realistic teeth and occasionally his tongues. The twin green mouths were usually expressionless and only moved when he spoke or ate. His actual eyes were located vertically from one another on his face. One of them was the constantly opened bottom mouth, which was usually contorted when Gyokko displayed emotions and featured a golden-yellow iris, a honey-brown center and visible veins. Similar in appearance, the other one was seated at the center of his forehead. Three brown dots were on top of the latter eye. The kanji for |Jōgen}} was engraved on his forehead's eye, and the daiji for |Go}} was engraved on his mouth's.

When in battle, Gyokko was shown to molt and transform into his true form, which bore heavy resemblance to a merman. In this state, Gyokko retained his facial features and muscular physique, but now possessed a more humanoid body. His two large arms replaced his various small ones, alongside webbed hands with turquoise scales and sharpened fingers. Although he didn't have legs, Gyokko instead acquired a long, teal, serpent-like tail. He also grew much larger, became covered in transparent scales, and attained dark markings on various places around his body. While he still kept his cornrow-styled "hair", Gyokko obtained several more blue-violet fins across his body: he had a long mane comprised of them, which lined up the top-half of his tail. Additionally, the mouth which displayed his lower eye had four stitches - two on each side, giving it a ragdoll-like appearance.

entities.name: Gyomei Himejima
entities.description:
Gyomei is a hulking figure in the Demon Slayer Corps. Standing as one of the tallest characters in the series, he easily towers over his fellow Hashira. He is a powerfully built, extremely muscular man, with a slightly tanned skin tone. He has medium, spiky, black hair that was shaved along the sides of his head, and a prominent scar that ran horizontally across his forehead. Having been blind since childhood, he has white eyes with no visible irises or pupils. His eyes frequently tear-up when he gets emotional.

Gyomei wears a standard black Demon Slayer Corps uniform, tinted dark gray in the anime. His uniform consisted of a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar and long sleeves, featuring gold buttons, a left breast pocket, and the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform. However, Gyomei’s jacket was heavily customized; it was worn with only the last button fastened, and the sleeves of his jacket and undershirt rolled up. His uniform is secured at the waist with the standard white belt and paired of matching tattsuke-hakama pants. Beneath the uniform, he wore a purple kimono, complete with a prominent white yuban collar. Around his lower legs, he wears a white bandages wrapped around his shins in place of traditional kyahan. For footwear, Gyomei wears white zōri sandals with gray straps, notably without tabi socks. Draped over his shoulders was a distinct olive-green happi, which featured religious iconography. The collared frame of the happi bears the kanji for |Namu Amida Butsu}} from the top-down, along with the separate kanji all over at the back. Around his neck, he sports a large red-beaded necklace and carried a set of red ojuzu beads when not in battle.

During his time as a monk and caretaker, Gyomei wore a similar hairstyle to his current appearance. His simple attire consisted of a olive green yukata and pants, tied with a lighter green sash. Physically, he was noticeably shorter and slimmer due to malnutrition brought on by his unfavourable living situation and his own willingness to go hungry and let the children he cared for eat instead. He sustained his signature scar from a demon attack during this period.

He sustained a slash across his face after being struck by a Blood Demon Art crescent blade from Kokushibo. His left leg from the knee below was later severed during the battle against Muzan.

entities.name: Gyutaro
entities.description:
Over a century ago during the Edo period, Gyutaro was a human who worked as a debt collector in the Rashomon Riverbank of Yoshiwara, the lowest class in the Entertainment District, before he and Daki were turned into demons personally by Doma, who was Upper Rank Six at the time.

Gyutaro was a tall man of pale gray complexion speckled with black blotches. His anatomy was quite strange in that his upper torso, arms, and legs were all defined with musculature, whereas his waist was incredibly skinny to the point of looking skeletal, with his pelvis jutting out at an unnatural angle. His spine was prominently visible through his back, and he was usually shown being hunched over. Gyutaro possessed thin eyes that were slanted drastically downwards at the sides, giving him a permanently haggard gaze. His miotic irises were green with a dark orange center, and his sclera was a bright yellow-orange with visible veins. The kanji for |Jogen}} is carved across his right eye, and the daiji for |Roku}} carved on his left. During his fight with the Demon Slayers, he lends his left eye to Daki and spends the rest of his battle with said eye shut, giving him a permanent wink.

He had unruly black hair that transitioned to a brighter lime green around the crown of his head, worn messily in uneven bangs and several locks, along a messy tied top head of his hair. His body and limbs had noticeable ink-like markings in the form of black spots on his body and a flowing water-like pattern on his face. His fingernails and toenails were black. He also had a full set of sharp, interlocking teeth. Gyutaro was described to look very ugly.

Gyutaro wore little, only sporting a pair of baggy gray-blue pants and seven pieces of pattern dark red and black cloth to decorate his body, one large one around his neck and three smaller ones around each arm; two pair for each biceps, and two on both his wrists. After Tengen's failed attempt to decapitate Gyutaro by holding on to the tip of his dual Nichirin cleavers, the cloth around his neck was cut and he spent the remainder of his fight bare-necked, implying that Gyutaro was one of the few demons who wore clothing not made from their flesh.

entities.name: Hairo
entities.description:
Hairo was a relatively tall young man with an athletic build. He had very spiky black hair with two chin-length bangs. As a member of the Twelve Kizuki, he had the kanji for |Ka}} and the daiji for |Ni}} etched on his left eye. Hairo also had many black spike-like patterns framing his face.

He wears an Western-style light colored suit with a black buckled belt with saggy pants and black boots. Over this, he wears a black cloak similar in appearance to a cape with protruding collars. Finally he wears a white sailor hat with a wolf emblem on its front center. He was frequently seen wielding a revolver.

Hairo was sadistic, vengeful, and ruthless. He did not care for the numerous innocent lives in Tokyo, or that of the Demon Slayers assigned to find him, only focuses on his revenge against the Flame Hashira who tormented him. Hairo was also a skilled torturer, recalling in his holding of Mitsuri that he knew the human limits when under extreme pain and he planned to use his experience to torture her before he would kill the young Demon Slayer. Most of all, his anger towards Shinjuro Rengoku essentially controlled who he was and blinded him from seeing that the Demon Slayer facing him was not the same man from the past but his son. Such was his fear of Shinjuro that Hairo believed that his entire life was dictated by anger and fear since that day, even remarking that he might die of sheer indignation. He had a habit of shooting himself in the head or mouth to alleviate his tension and anger when faced with a stressful situation.

In his battle with Shinjuro's son Kyojuro, Hairo was initially motivated by his false belief that he was facing Shinjuro; upon realizing he was mistaken, he seemingly lost most of his rage and motivation for revenge. Additionally, despite his proficiency in using guns, Hairo seemed to despise them, as during his last confrontation with Kyojuro, the demon wielded a katana to face him after running out of ammunition. In that moment, Hairo showed pride in his swordsmanship and demanded the Demon Slayer duel him and be allowed to kill him with a blade. In his final moments, Hairo even acknowledged that Kyojuro's swordsmanship surpassed his own.

entities.description:
Hanako was a young girl with pale skin and black, shoulder-length hair, along with fringes above her eyebrows. Like the rest of her family, Hanako had white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and dark red at the bottom.

Hanako wore a peach Iromuji kimono with a pale pink haori over it. She also wore a dark peach obi with a pink obijime and a beige-colored obiage. Under all of this, she wore a white juban.

Hanako had a very close bond with her family. She loved her oldest brother and sometimes liked to seek attention from him. Like her other siblings, she was upset about not being able to go with her brother to the village. She is also seen helping her family do household chores and scolding her siblings if they did something naughty.

Hanako grew up on a mountain alongside her siblings and mother. She was the youngest daughter of the Kamado family.

entities.name: Hand Demon
entities.description:
The |Te Oni}} is the primary antagonist of the Final Selection Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a notorious demon who killed thirteen of Sakonji Urokodaki's apprentices, including Sabito and Makomo, as well as at least fifty other would-be Demon Slayers.

The Hand Demon was a monstrously large, veiny, hulking monster distinguished by olive-green skin, blood-red fingernails, and beady yellow eyes with cross-hatched pupils. After devouring fifty humans, he lost his original humanoid appearance, growing massively in size and gaining a wide mouth filled with jagged teeth. The Hand Demon acquired so many arms that he was forced to discard his clothing, using his limbs to cover his body instead, and abandon bipedal movement to crawl on all hands like an animal.

The Hand Demon was ruthless in his treatment of humans, immediately killing them and even attacking the ones who fled. He bore a great hatred for Sakonji Urokodaki, cursing him for defeating and trapping him in the wisteria-riddled Mount Fujikasane, and vowing to kill all of his apprentices for revenge. He was also very sadistic, gleefully explaining his murder of Sabito and Makomo to Tanjiro Kamado. Despite this, the Hand Demon had a deep fear of death, being too afraid to close his eyes after Tanjiro beheaded him.

When he was human, he had a habit of asking his older brother to hold his hand, a trait which made his sibling label him a scaredy-cat. In his final moments, the Hand Demon extended a hand to Tanjiro for him to hold, shedding tears of gratitude when his request was granted.

entities.name: Headless Demon
entities.description:
The し|Kubi neshi oni}} was one of the dolls controlled by Mother of the Spider Family, deployed as her strongest weapon and a last resort against her confrontation with the Demon Slayer Corps. However, unlike Mother's other "dolls" which consisted of unwilling Demon Slayer manipulated by her threads, the Headless Demon was essentially a non-sentient marionette.

This demon was noted for its extremely tall and muscular frame, towering far above humans and possessing nearly the same stature as Father of the Spider Family. Its most distinct feature was its missing head, which, as indicated by the unclean wound along its neck, was likely ripped off by Mother in an attempt to keep the demon alive. Its two forearms appeared as bladed, spider-like legs that extend further than normal, giving the demon tremendous reach. Its skin was a dull purple, and had visible bulging veins throughout its body. The demon's only attire consisted of a pair of torn and weathered beige pants, with the left pant leg being completely torn open, and a loosely tied ribbon that acted somewhat like a belt.

This demon was one of the many demons found on Mount Natagumo. He was used as a puppet by Mother of Rui's Spider Family, being her last line of defense in case any threat got too close to her location. How he was transformed and what happened to his head, or if he was even a sentient demon in the first place is unknown.

During the mission on Mount Natagumo, after Tanjiro Kamado and Inosuke Hashibira saw their Demon Slayer Corps comrades die, they continued advancing in search of the demon responsible. Mother, seeing that they were about to find her, decided to release the Headless Demon, who was hanging, tangled in spiderweb threads. The Headless Demon was sent to attack them immediately upon encountering Tanjiro and Inosuke, initially surprising them by the absence of a neck they could cut with their katanas. However, Tanjiro quickly devised a solution: deploy a monk's hood cut to slash it diagonally through its torso.

entities.name: Hinaki Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
Hinaki was a girl who had pale skin and large, purple eyes. She had white, shoulder-length hair styled into a blunt bob with bangs and sported a red ribbon on the right side of her head.

Hinaki was usually seen wearing a dark blue Hōmongi kimono decorated with purple flowers along with a maroon obi and a pink obiage and juban under everything, nearly identical to her twin Nichika.

Hinaki was usually very quiet, but kind and committed to her duties. Kiriya describes his older sister as smarter and more skilled than him. She loved her parents very much and was very loyal to them even to the point of dying alongside them. During her final moments, she showed no fear towards Muzan Kibutsuji intruding upon their home; she simply played and sung with her twin sister, accepting their demise.

Born to Kagaya and Amane Ubuyashiki, Hinaki was the eldest of the couple's quintuplets. As such, she and the second oldest of the five, Nichika, often served as assistants to their parents together, following orders and being highly committed to their duties.

entities.name: Hinatsuru
entities.description:
Hinatsuru is a young woman of average height with a curvaceous yet slender figure, pale skin, and long black hair typically styled in a ponytail. Her large, almond-shaped violet eyes are framed by thin eyelashes and eyebrows, and a distinctive beauty mark under her left eye adds to her gentle and kind appearance.

Hinatsuru wears a short, sleeveless lavender dress with an irregular square pattern of a darker color, which has a plunging neckline that exposes her cleavage, and secured tight with a red-violet colored obi where she presumably stores her kunai. She wears brown fishnet socks that reach up to her mid-thigh along with light colored sandals with purple straps. In a flashback, she is also seen wearing long, fingerless fishnet gloves.

When retired, Hinatsuru wears a more modest version of her usual attire, consisting of a lavender kimono with an irregular square pattern of darker hues and lifted sleeves, paired with a white yuban underneath that has an open window revealing her mid-chest. The outfit includes white straps tied and laced in an X pattern around her shoulders and back, extending down to her ankles for added coverage. A fuchsia obi is tied around her waist, secured with a lighter purple-pink obijime in the middle. She retains her purple-strapped sandals.

Hinatsuru is kind, calm, nurturing, and honest, even when dealing with the antics of her co-wives towards each other. Despite only being slightly older than the two, Hinatsuru displays far more maturity and often acts to mediate situations between Makio and Suma, as seen when she spoke with Makio about Tengen and how he lives his life differently to that of traditional shinobi, despite Makio's confusion.

entities.description:
Hiroshi was a boy of average height for his age, with large round blue eyes and a light skin tone. His hair was shaved along the sides, except for a small crop at the top of his head styled into a mohawk. He bore a great resemblance to his brother Genya and his mother.

Hiroshi wore a navy blue kimono and grey pants.

Hiroshi was a loving and caring child, much like his siblings. He became worried for his mother's safety when she did not come home and decided to stay up all night till she arrived, eagerly rushing to greet her when she came home eventually.

He also loved his siblings in the same way, as he addressed his older brother Genya when he woke up to see him awake and Sanemi gone.

entities.description:
Hisa is a short, old woman with wrinkled skin and thick eyebrows. Her bulky, gray hair is tied into a medium sized bun with two strands poking out behind her ears.

In most of her appearances, Hisa is seen wearing a plain maroon kimono with a purple obi. She also wears a pair of black zōri sandals with white tabi socks.

Hisa comes off as a very kind and welcoming person, bringing in the injured Demon Slayers without hesitation and providing them with commodities for recovery. Despite Inosuke Hashibira's impolite nature, she proved to be very patient with him and doesn't appear to be affected by his remarks.

Inosuke noted that even with his enhanced perception, Hisa's kind demeanor made it impossible for him to detect her presence because she bore no ounce of ill-will towards him.

entities.name: Horned Demon
entities.description:
The |Tsunojō Oni}} was a demon that lived in the Tsuzumi Mansion.

The Horned Demon was a heavy-set demon with a rotund build, and visible bulging veins all across on the majority of his body. He has shoulder length black hair, with a center split and a single horn in the middle of his forehead. He has distinctive red eyes with vertical pupils, slanted in an upward position, as well as thick protruding lips.

He wore green hakama pants with a brown vest.

The Horned Demon was prideful and confident, as seen when he showed no hesitation to attack at the sight of Inosuke Hashibira, even boasting about the fact that he'd soon taste Inosuke's flesh and sarcastically complimenting his attack. He was also confident enough in himself to physically confront Kyogai, a demon with a potent Blood Demon Art, and even rip off the demon's back drum. However, his pride and lack of caution quickly became his downfall as he underestimated Inosuke, showing a lack of ability to properly size up his opponent before fighting them.

entities.name: Hotaru Haganezuka
entities.description:
Hotaru wears a black yukata with sunflower-patterned haori over it and has his head wrapped in a spotted head scarf. Like the rest of the swordsmiths, his face is concealed by a Hyottoko mask (wooden festival mask) to conceal his identity. When traveling, he wears a large, woven hat with floral wind chimes hung on top of the head scarf.

When enraged at Tanjiro losing his sword for the second time, Hotaru takes off his haori and opens up his yukata to show his chest a bit more. He also turns his head scarf into a headband, using it to display two knives on his head and revealing his long black hair.

During the Swordsmith Village Arc, he is seen with a more muscular build after having trained in the mountains. In addition, a lock of his hair is exposed from his scarf.

Unmasked, Hotaru's long, black hair is fully freed. He is revealed to have orange-colored eyes coupled with distinctly shaped thick eyebrows. After being attacked by Upper Rank Five, Gyokko, Hotaru now possesses several deep scars and cuts across his body, including an X-shaped one that permanently blinded his left eye.

entities.name: Jigoro Kuwajima
entities.description:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle

Jigoro was a short, elderly man with a pale skin complexion, visible forehead wrinkles, and straight scar with six prongs running along his left cheekbone. He has large, slanted eyes with small irises. He had notably bushy eyebrows and a large moustache, as well as slick white hair that he wore smoothed down to puff out around the base of his head, with what would've been a fringe also swept back away from his face. Jigoro was also missing his right leg, with a wooden peg taking its place, this feature made more prominent in the anime than the manga.

Jigoro wore a jinbei kimono like the one worn by Sakonji Urokodaki, only with a yellow-brown base color and a pale triangle pattern in the stead of the blue and water-patterned theme Sakonji sports. He also carried a thick wooden cane with him to support his body due to age and his missing leg.

Although Jigoro's tenure as an active Hashira is never shown, a back-view cameo in Kizuna no Kiseki showcases that Jigoro looked more or less the same to his current appearance, with the exception of having black hair in his youth.

entities.name: Kaburamaru
entities.description:
Kaburamaru is a medium-sized albino Japanese rat snake with reddish pink eyes and large fangs on either side of his mouth. His scales and underbelly are both white due to albinism.

Kaburamaru seems to be an intelligent animal rather than an ordinary snake. In most situations, he is usually seen flicking his tongue to sense his surroundings while coiled around Obanai's neck. He appears to be of similar personality to Obanai himself, as seen when he angrily hissed at Suma for chiding the Serpent Hashira for his late arrival to Yoshiwara. He also seems to be attached to Mitsuri Kanroji, as seen when she stroked Kaburamaru in the past. Additionally, he shed tears as Mitsuri was dying, succumbing to her wounds.

After Obanai's death, Kaburamaru appears to have mellowed out somewhat, as he was shown being entrusted to Sanemi Shinazugawa and later Kanao Tsuyuri, whereas he was initially always with Obanai from the beginning. He is also seen smelling Tanjiro Kamado's face in curiosity.

During his life in captivity to become a sacrifice to the Serpent Demon, Obanai found that a small snake had slithered into his cell. Being the only living thing that didn't want him dead at the time, he took the snake in as a companion. Once he made his escape, he had the snake with him when he fled. The two would end up being rescued shortly after by the Flame Hashira of then, Shinjuro Rengoku.

entities.name: Kagaya Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
Kagaya was a man of frail physicality, average stature, and very pale skin complexion. He had shoulder-length black hair that was parted in the middle. Due to his family curse, Kagaya looked as if he was rotting alive, with large portions of his skin appearing with a sickly, shriveled pink hue that began from the left side of his forehead and gradually spread across his body. Additionally, the curse caused him to go blind as it affected his eyes, turning his sclera from white to black (light purple in the anime) and his pupils from a dark purple to a light purple, matching his cursed skin. When he was first formally introduced in Tanjiro Kamado's trial, Kagaya's curse covered the upper half of his head, but during the last moments of his life only months later, the curse has spread to his entire body, leaving him covered completely with bandages apart from his mouth to speak.

Muzan described him as physically repulsive and pitiful, as well as having the scent of a corpse. Additionally, during their meeting, Kagaya was nearly completely bedridden, having been confined to his household since the battle in Yoshiwara: even the act of getting up caused him great pain and he coughed blood trying to do so. He was also prone to bleeding from his mouth and eyes. Throughout all his appearances, Kagaya sported a gentle and relaxed smile that never wavered, always appearing serene and calm no matter the situation.

While serving as Oyakata, he primarily wore a black yukata, with a white undershirt and tied with a weaved brown obi. Atop this, he wore a white kimono with a flame-like pattern appearing from the bottom and colored with a blend of light-purple and orange. He wore a pair of plain white socks, and a pair of sandals with brown straps. When meeting Muzan during the last moments of his life, Kagaya wore a wavy-striped kimono with a blend of light-purple and grey.

Kagaya had a calm, dedicated, and composed demeanor, showing genuine care about the members of the Demon Slayers, whom he considered as his children. He was also able to handle criticism well and was honest about his weaknesses; one being his inability to become a Demon Slayer despite being their main leader. In order to make up for this, he remembered every single member of the Corps and visited the deceased members at their cemetery on a daily basis until he could no longer move due to his illness.

entities.name: Kaigaku
entities.description:
Kaigaku was a former Demon Slayer and Zenitsu Agatsuma's senior disciple under the former Thunder Hashira, Jigoro Kuwajima. However, sometime during the Hashira Training, Kaigaku went on a mission and encountered Upper Rank One, Kokushibo, quickly surrendering to him to save his life and later becoming a demon.

As a human, Kaigaku was a muscular young man of average height and pale complexion. He had short, spiky black hair with two thick strands framing each sides of his face along with bangs at the front, and a pair of dull, cold teal eyes framed by thick, arched eyebrows. His expression was often unfriendly, and he had a semi-permanent snarl.

While training under Jigoro, Kaigaku wore a black kimono with a white collar. It was worn loosely to expose his chest and his pendants, which are decorated with gold magatama beads and a blue string. When he became a Demon Slayer, Kaigaku wore the Corps' standard uniform, which consisted of a navy gakuran-style button-up jacket, with a stand-up collar and long sleeves, featuring silver buttons and a shirt pocket on the left breast, with the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform. Beneath the jacket, he wore a white long-sleeved collared undershirt. His uniform also included a pair of matching navy tattsuke-hakama held up by a white belt, tucked into a black fabric of cloth wrapped around his ankles. On his feet, he wore navy tabi socks and a pair of zori sandals with bright blue straps.

After Kaigaku became a demon, he gained four navy blue flame-like markings on both sides of his cheeks, emerald green irises (originally colored cyan in the manga) with black sclera, elongated canines resembling fangs, sickly pale skin, sharp blackened nails, and pointed ears. By becoming a member of the Twelve Kizuki and rising to the position of Upper Rank Six, his eyes became etched with the kanji for |Jōgen}} on his right, and daiji of |Roku}} on his left. Kaigaku still retained his signature kimono, which was secured with a blue obi over a stylized version of his Demon Slayer uniform that has yellow flame-like markings near the chest area and an unbuttoned collar. His forearms are seemingly wrapped in white kyahan-like material, and he wears additional necklaces on his wrists. The magatama on his pendants are now blue instead of yellow, and have a light turquoise strings instead of blue.

entities.name: Kamanue
entities.description:
Kamanue was a short young man of pale skin complexion. His face was decorated by a thick dark-green line that ran under his eyes and across his nose, stretching vertically on his forehead to form a horizontal line. Four large dots were also placed on his face: one at each end of the line on his cheeks, one in the middle of his forehead, and a final one below his lower lip.

His eyes were cat-like in shape, the pupils slit and the irises pale blue with a white ring around the sides. The kanji for |Ka}} and the daiji for |Roku}} was etched onto his left eye, which signified his position. Kamanue also possessed dark brown hair with bright orange tips, which he wore swept back but fluffed out on either side of his head and neck. He wore a white haori with a yellow scale pattern down the sleeves, as well as a white button-up shirt and dark hakama pants.

Kamanue was a very anxious and restive individual. He constantly wore a scared expression due to the fact that he felt weak and vulnerable as the lowest of the Lower Ranks. He appeared to be constantly skittish during his short time at the Infinity Castle.

As with most demons, his loyalty to Muzan Kibutsuji, though steadfast, was built on great fear. He sweated profusely when he heard the Demon King's voice. Frozen in terror, he was unable to say a word when Muzan questioned his loyalty and challenged him to continue speaking.

entities.name: Kanae Kocho
entities.description:
Several years prior to the present story, she was slain by Upper Rank Two, Doma.

Kanae was a girl of a slender build. She was taller than her sister, Shinobu, but still petite next to most Demon Slayers. Her lips were notably pink compared to her pale complexion. She had long, straight black hair that reached just below her waist, with two shorter portions coming over her shoulders; arched, ear-length bangs adorned both sides of her face. Her eyes were faintly violet-tinted, centered with darker purple and sparkly reflections, slanting towards the sides of her face.

Kanae wore the standard Demon Slayer Corps uniform, which is black in the manga and dark purple in the anime. Her uniform consisted of a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar and long sleeves. It featured gold buttons down the front, a shirt pocket on the left breast, and the kanji for |Metsu}} on the back. Beneath the jacket, she wore a white long-sleeved and collared undershirt. Her outfit was fastened at the waist with the standard white belt. She wore traditional tattsuke-hakama pants matching the tone of her uniform. Around her lower legs, Kanae wrapped a strip of black fabric, functioning similarly to kyahan, and wore dark purple tabi socks. On her feet, she wore zōri sandals with pale purple straps.

Over her uniform, Kanae wore a white butterfly-patterned haori (later worn by Shinobu) that transitioned to pale turquoise, then pink, toward the lower sleeves and the hem. The edges of the garment were trimmed in black and decorated with pale turquoise spots. She also sported a pair of green butterfly ornaments, which featured pink trim on the rims finished off with a decoration of white speckles. After her death, her adoptive younger sister, Kanao, began wearing one of the pins as a memento.

entities.name: Kanata Kamado
entities.description:
Kanata is a young man of reasonable height with short black hair, cut into a neat fringe that hangs over his forehead. His eyes are gentle and of a dark violet color with paler rings of lavender around their edges, and he's usually seen with an expressionless face. Overall, his appearance bears a strong resemblance to that of his ancestor Kanao Tsuyuri.

Kanata wears his high school's uniform, consisting of a pale blue dress shirt with a sleeveless, white v-neck cardigan worn over the top, and plain black pants. He wears a black necktie, as well as a pair of dark brown dress shoes and a watch with a white band on his left wrist.

Kanata takes after Kanao in terms of personality as well as appearance, as he is often seen with a blank expression and communicates with most everyone in a monotonous manner. He is said to say whatever is in his mind right away. Kanata also appears to be rather mathematical, as he accurately counted and recalled the amount of times he told his brother to wake up. However, it's shown that he'll drop this personality when around Toko Agatsuma, as he's seen smiling at her and calling her cute when they meet up on the walk to school.

Kanata is first seen trying to wake up his brother, Sumihiko, so he won't be late for school. He remarks that he's told him to get up 28 times that morning, and when a dozing Sumihiko replies that he is up, Kanata argues that he isn't, and tells his brother that he's an ugly sleeper.

entities.description:
Kanata was a girl with a pale, light skin and a set of large, purple eyes. Her hair was shaped into a blunt white bob haircut similar to the rest of her siblings. She adorned an elongated wisteria headpiece on the right side of her head as opposed to the left side like her brother.

During Final Selection, Kanata wore a purple, flower-patterned Hōmongi kimono with a dark indigo juban under it. She also sported a sheen green obi with a dark indigo obiage and a plum-red obijime tying it.

During the events in the Infinity Castle, Kanata wore a purple Edo komon kimono with a white juban under it, sporting a black obi with a white obiage and a pink obijime, completely identical to her twin sister Kuina Ubuyashiki.

Kanata's first appearance during the Final Selection depicts herself to be a professional, intelligent, and focused individual on her given task of explaining the proper details regarding the exam.

entities.name: Kazumi
entities.description:
Kazumi is a young man with dark-brown hair and brown eyes with white pupils.

He wears a dull blue iromuji kimono with a dark-colored obi and light-brown haori. He was eventually seen with bruises in his face.

Kazumi was shown to be a loving and kind person who enjoyed spending time together with his fiancée. Despite his grief over her disappearance, he was shown to be quite trusting, as he believed in Tanjiro's way of trying to find Satoko. Upon learning that she was in fact dead and Tanjiro had encouraged him to move on, Kazumi became upset and asked how he could know his pain, only to quickly realize his savior did indeed endure a terrible loss as well, becoming regretful of his harsh words.

Unlike most civilians, Kazumi seems to know some knowledge about demons and Demon Slayers, having heard about their existence through rumors, though he remains surprised to see them in reality.

entities.name: Keizo
entities.description:
Keizo was a middle-aged man with a muscular body, fair skin tone, and unshaven stubble. He kept a shoulder length black hair, which was tied, while having thin strands over his forehead. His eyes were usually closed, and his eyebrows appears to be quite bushy.

Keizo wore a Jiu-Jitsu gi uniform that consisted of a top and a pair of pants that is tied together with a dan black belt with the kanji for his fighting style |Soryū}} at the back.

Keizo was a kind and cheerful person who did his best to protect others with his abilities, and he was optimistic and empathic enough to assign Hakuji, a former convict, to take care of his daughter, teaching him his Soryu Style of martial arts and ultimately welcoming him into his family by allowing him to marry Koyuki and be the next head of his dojo. His memory and instructions impacted Hakuji enough even after his transformation as a demon and the loss of his memories, especially after meeting Tanjiro Kamado, who shared his same beliefs and benevolence.

One day, Keizo saved a man from bandits, who gave him the land his dojo was on as a gift. He was married and had a daughter, Koyuki. When a nearby kenjutsu dojo wanted his land for their own and were unable to cease it, they resorted to harassing potential students of the dojo, leaving Keizo with no one to teach. As such, he took on handyman jobs to make amends and had to leave Koyuki's care to his wife, who was extremely ill. Eventually the stress of Koyuki's needs and the fear of seeing her child die young led his wife to drown herself. After that, he did his best to balance making money and caring for Koyuki, even though he did not believe she would live long either.

entities.name: Kie Kamado
entities.description:
Kie was a woman with a noticeably light complexion. She had kind and white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and purple at the bottom. She also possessed a small beauty mark beneath the left side of her lower lip. Kie had black hair, worn in a messy bun with a few loose strands left to dangle over her face. Her eldest daughter Nezuko bears a striking resemblance to her, especially in facial structure and hair color.

Kie wore a purple and cream-checkered kimono with a white and long-sleeved kappōgi over the top. She also sported a white tenugui around her head, which covered most of her hair.

As the mother of six children, Kie was always seen displaying a very loving, caring and kind personality. Since she was a single mother, she always tried to be as warm and affectionate to her children as she could to fill the gap her husband left. She was very protective of her children, but at the same time, she also taught them to be independent. She demonstrated a positive and encouraging vibe, especially during her appearance in Nezuko's subconsciousness, encouraging her to wake up to help her brother through the fight and reminding her to do her best.

At some point in her life, Kie married Tanjuro and gave birth to six children. After her husband’s death, she was left to take care of their children by herself, managing to support and keep her whole family safe and sound through all of the hardships they endured.

entities.name: Kiriya Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
Kiriya is a boy with light, pale skin and large, purple eyes. He initially had the same hairstyle as the rest of his siblings; a blunt bob with a fringe covering his eyebrows, colored black. As he was raised as a girl, he takes on a more feminine appearance during his first appearance, including having pronounced eyelashes and red lips.

During Final Selection, Kiriya wore a purple uchikake kimono with patterned flowers and a green obi, supported with a white obiage and indigo obijime along with a white juban under everything. His head is adorned with a wisteria headpiece.

After Kiriya becomes the leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, he stops dressing like a girl and removes any feminine features, such as his makeup and his wisteria headpiece. He instead wears a black kimono with a long white haori that is reminiscent of his father. He also parts the fringe on his hair, adopting a hair style akin to his ancestors.

More than a hundred years after the disbandment of the Corps, Kiriya is still alive in the present day as the oldest living person in Japan. He wears the same clothing he wore after succeeding his father, although he is shown to have grown bald with only a few strands of hair, gained heavy wrinkles, and is very diminutive.

entities.name: Kiyo Terauchi
entities.description:
Kiyo is a girl with light skin and a set of circular, dark brown eyes. She has shoulder-length black hair with six thin bangs framing her face, along with two light pink butterfly clips on each side of her head.

Kiyo wears a long, white nurse dress tied with a dark, reddish-pink bow around her waist. She also sports white socks with sandals that have reddish-pink straps.

Despite her family being slain by demons, Kiyo is a kind and cheerful child. Just like the other servants of the Butterfly Mansion. For example, she offered Tanjiro many different snacks during Rehabilitation Training, granted his request, along with Sumi and Naho, to beat his blanket with blanket beaters if he stopped doing Total Concentration Breathing when he was sleeping, and showed worry about his health when he had a nonstop fever, telling him that she was going to have to tell Shinobu if the situation continued. She is shown to care a lot about her colleagues in the Butterfly Mansion, as she was crying when Kanae died and prayed for Shinobu and Kanao's well-being in battle.

After her family had been attacked by demons, Kiyo was taken in by the Butterfly Mansion by the Kocho sisters, along with Sumi, Naho and Aoi.

entities.name: Kiyoshi
entities.description:
Kiyoshi is a young man in his early teens, with slightly longer black hair than Shoichi's. He has hazel brown eyes like his siblings and wears a persimmon colored haori over his green kimono.

Kiyoshi is a brave young boy who, despite his very understandable fear, managed to survive on his own in a house with three demons all trying to devour him. He is intelligent and crafty enough to use Kyogai's tsuzumi against him in order to survive. Tanjiro Kamado was impressed by Kiyoshi's will that allowed him to hold out for so long under these conditions.

Due to to his rare blood, the young teen Kiyoshi was targeted as a marechi by demons and taken by force to Tsuzumi Mansion. There, three demons fought over who was going to eat him and the ensuing fight caused Kyogai to lose one of his tsuzumi drums. Kiyoshi took the drum and used it to transport himself away from the demons.

Kiyoshi strikes the tsuzumi whenever danger is near and holds out until help finally arrives. His younger sister Teruko appears to save him alongside a Demon Slayer named Tanjiro. Tanjiro dresses Kiyoshi's wounds and asks for an update on the situation.

entities.name: Koinatsu
entities.description:
Koinatsu is a young woman with fair-skin and soft features. She has large, but relaxed bronze-colored eyes and small eyebrows with black hair.

She is dressed as an upper classed oiran/tayū, having date-hyōgo Nihongami-styled hair with multiple gold-colored hirauchi kanzashi hairpins supporting both the maegami and tabo sections of her hair. She wore an elaborate Susohiki/Hikizuri (trailing skirt) kimono, being purple with white polka-dots as its pattern, with a peach-colored haori with multiple golden clouds near the hem and cuffs. Underneath, she wore a yellow juban that reached her ankles. She has a pink-sakura colored obi with a Fukura-suzume styled-musubi knot exposed at the front, and tall, black three-legged sanmaiba/koma-geta or mitsu-ashi shoes.

Koinatsu is a kind and gracious woman, readily thanking her kamuro/shinzō subordinates and awarding them with candy and story-telling for a job well done, as well as smiling at their happiness. She is so sweet, she spoils everyone to the point where even the Okami gets mad at her for it. In addition, she worries deeply for their well-being when she was to leave to marry a prospective suitor, especially in regards to her inability to investigate the various disappearances that plagued her district. She also seemed to dislike the spreading of rumors, chiding her subordinates for discussing them with Tanjiro Kamado, presumably for misinformation. She is also an observant woman, having known that Tanjiro was a boy from the moment he arrived at her establishment.

Koinatsu was an Oiran in the Tokito House, and the highest ranking courtesan in Yoshiwara District. Due to her status, she was one of the most revered people in all of Yoshiwara.

entities.name: Kokushibo
entities.description:
Nearly five centuries ago during the Sengoku Era, Kokushibo was a human by the name of |Tsugikuni Michikatsu}}, a former Demon Slayer, and the older twin brother of Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the strongest Demon Slayer to ever live.

Kokushibo is also the ancestor of Muichiro Tokito and Yuichiro Tokito, and is responsible for turning Zenitsu Agatsuma's senior, Kaigaku, into a demon, who then defected to the Twelve Kizuki as the new Upper Rank Six.

Kokushibo is a tall man of muscular build and pale skin complexion. He possesses long, spiky black hair with red tips that he kept in a ponytail, along with two shoulder-length, flowing, wavy bangs on each side that reached to his collarbone. His most notable features are the three sets of eyes on his face with yellow irises and red flesh sclera that have black, straight lines diverging from each iris. His middle set of eyes have the kanji of "|Jōgen}}" on engraved on his left eye, and daiji for "|Ichi}}" on his right. His other sets of eyes feature black pupils and a cracked pattern in the irises. His top set of eyes replaced his eyebrows. Kokushibo also possesses flame-like Demon Slayer Marks on the top left side of his forehead that extended down to his left temple, and the bottom right of his cheek that extended down to his neck. His appearance was described as profound and majestic by Muichiro Tokito.

Kokushibo adorned a purple-and-black hexagonal-patterned nagagi kimono and black umanori-styled hakama pants tied with a white uwa-obi. He also wore a pair of zōri with purple straps, and white tabi socks. He carried a fleshy katana at his waist that has eyes in the space between the [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Tsuka tsuka ito] wrapping of the handle of his sword. The tsuba and blade were shown to have eyes and veins. The scabbard was also fleshy in appearance.

entities.name: Kotetsu
entities.description:
Kotetsu is a child of short stature, pale skin tone, and black hair. He wears a yellow striped yukata, a red vest on top of it, and a Hyottoko mask (with notable eyebrows and cheek prints) that fully conceals his face. However, it's later revealed that Kotetsu's actual face is similar to his mask, having the same wide eyes, bushy eyebrows, and rosy cheeks. The kanji for |Hyottoko}} is written on the back of his vest.

Kotetsu is a kind and energetic child. He is full of passion for his job of maintaining the battle doll Yoriichi Type Zero, even though he has not yet mastered the repairs. This causes him much initial grief and fear, as should the doll break, no one but him is skilled enough to fix it. However, after meeting Tanjiro Kamado he realizes that he cannot give up. He is often very frank and blunt at times. This can be to his own detriment however, as he has no problems being blunt about the notoriously ill-tempered Hotaru Haganezuka who retaliates by assaulting the boy. Despite this, he means the best and tries his hardest to help those around him.

While at times he seems insecure and weak-willed, as shown when he attempts to argue with Muichiro Tokito's harsh but true statements, Kotetsu can also be hot-headed and barbed-tongued. Without Muichiro to see him in the company of Tanjiro, he openly insulted the Hashira on multiple occasions, which shocked Tanjiro with his sharp contrast in demeanor.

Despite initially bearing a grudge against the Mist Hashira, Kotetsu openly wept and repeatedly thanked Muichiro for saving him from a demon attack, even taking back his hatred and insults (which Muichiro did not even know about). He began begging Muichiro to save Kozo Kanamori and Hotaru Haganezuka, showing that he is open to changing his feelings towards people and being on better terms.

entities.name: Kotoha Hashibira
entities.description:
Kotoha was a young woman of petite build and fair skin complexion. Her large emerald green eyes were framed by long black eyelashes, she had thin black eyebrows, a small nose, and pink lips. Her beauty was apparent as it made a lasting impression on even the apathetic Doma; her son Inosuke, who is also noted to be attractive by several people, was described as being strikingly similar to her by the demon, though Kotoha had softer features. She wore her long, black hair that was tied in a bun at the end.

Before she was taken in by the Eternal Paradise Faith, Kotoha only wore a tattered gray kimono with black line as a design and torn in several spots. When she became acquainted with Doma, she wore a lime green kimono to replaced her old one, decorated with darker green floral patterns and tied with a black obi. When she fled the cult, Kotoha was last seen wearing a similar lime green kimono, only this was decorated with lines and squares, and tied with a forest green obi.

Kotoha was a kind and loving woman, always showing appreciation to those around her. She treasured Inosuke dearly and would always sing lullabies to him when he was a baby, promising to always protect him no matter what. When meeting Doma, she found a fond liking in him due to him helping her escape the abuse she was facing from her family.

According to Doma, Kotoha was naive and not very smart. Doma describes her as a "beautiful" but innocent person. It's unknown whether he exaggerated her low intelligence due to his patronizing view of humans or if her kind nature coupled with the fact that she was partially blind from the beatings she endured from her husband made her ignorant to Doma's true nature. Quite contradictory however, Doma also claimed that she was also sharp despite her supposed stupidity, and that is how she found out about him being a demon who devoured his followers.

entities.name: Koyuki
entities.description:
Koyuki was a fair-skinned young woman with a short stature and a slim frame. She had large, rounded pink irises that transitioned to a lighter shade towards the lower rim. Her eyes had white flower-like shaped pupils. Her hair was black, tied up in a traditional Japanese updo. The front is framed by straight, parted bangs that curve softly toward her eyes with and two wispy strands that curve downwards from above each ear, fastened with a hairpin and decorated with a Kanzashi Kushi and three snowflake hairpins.

In her first appearance, Koyuki wore a light purple kimono underneath a black haori. Afterwards, Koyuki primarily wore a pink circle-patterned kimono that faded into a blue color. The kimono was decorated with black vine patterns and white snowflakes towards the bottom, tied together with a black obi. She alternatively wore a light-blue kimono with black floral patterns, tied with a yellow obi.

Koyuki had a kind, gentle, and caring personality; in her first interactions with Hakuji, she forwent her own problems and immediately asked the youth if he was alright after seeing the extent of his injuries following his pummelling from her father. After she recovered, Koyuki was bright and cheery, always having a wide smile on her face as she worked around the dojo; she was even seen blushing furiously when Keizo off-handedly noted that she liked Hakuji, staying tight-lipped and sweating in embarrassment at her father's revealing of her crush on him.

Though she could not control it, Koyuki was deeply burdened by her lengthy illness and despite presenting herself as personable to people, she gave up on the idea that she would ever heal and resigned herself to her fate. The suicide of her mother, who couldn't bear to watch her die, and Keizo's own acceptance that she would never recover weighed heavily on her mind, leaving her depressed. Despite her need of constant aid, she resented having so much attention being put on her, insisting that Hakuji must spend time away from for himself.

entities.name: Kozo Kanamori
entities.description:
Kozo is a man of short height and slim build, with neck-length black hair that spikes near the ends. His hands are covered in visible blisters and he wears a Hyottoko mask over his face, as do all residents of the Swordsmith Village. His attire consists of a long, pale shirt with a black haori, and brown pants.

Unmasked, Kozo is revealed to have a long slender face, with thick teardrop-shaped eyebrows identical to his mask, narrow eyes, and a birthmark under his right eye.

Kozo appears as a gentle, soft-spoken individual. He is capable of understanding the hot-blooded Hotaru Haganezuka and cares for others very much, as seen when he continues to protect Hotaru against an attack from Gyokko, Upper Rank Five, despite being critically injured. He also showed great worry for Muichiro Tokito, anxiously watching him battle Gyokko and becoming hysterical upon seeing the Hashira fall unconscious from the demon's poison.

However, when it comes to his swords, Kozo is very passionate, almost as much as Hotaru to a certain extent. When Inosuke Hashibira purposefully chips the two blades he received from him, the swordsmith became furious and threatened to kill him for damaging his work.

entities.name: Kuina Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
Kuina was a girl with a pale skin complexion with a set of large, purple eyes. She wore a white blunt bob hair with fringe covering her forehead. She also adorned an elongated wisteria headpiece on the left side of her head.

Kuina was usually seen wearing a purple, flower-patterned Edo komon kimono with a white juban under it. She also wore a black obi with a white obiage under it and a pink obijime it.

Kuina displayed her strong sense of loyalty and devotion to her brother as the new head of the Ubuyashiki Family and leader of the Demon Slayer Corps by being the one to forcefully reminded him of his duties as their leader. She even resorted to physical force to remind him of this by slapping him, in order to ensure he did not break down under the stress of his responsibilities.

Kuina was born into the Ubuyashiki family as one of the quintuplets. She was one of the youngest children in the family.

entities.name: Kyogai
entities.description:
Kyogai was a very tall, muscular, humanoid demon, possessing grayish skin with sharp markings on his forehead. He had shoulder-lenth, black hair, razor sharp teeth, pointy ears. His sclera was blood red with pupils that were a deep blue color. Due to his eyes being rolled up to the back of his head, his ireses were hidden. The kanji for |Ka}} and the daiji for |Roku}} was etched onto his right eye, which signified his position as Lower Rank Six of the Twelve Kizuki, but due to being deemed too weak, his rank was stripped and the eye containing his mark was slashed by Muzan, leaving behind a white X-shaped scar covering the number, signifying that he was no longer one of the Twelve Kizuki. Another one of his unique physical characteristics is that his stomach, shoulders, hips, and back all had drums protruding from them of which he uses for his Blood Demon Art.

As a human, Kyogai had virtually the same appearance as when he was a demon, except his scleras were white. He was shown wearing a brown and purple kimono, a purple patterned haori, and white tabi socks.

Kyogai was a relatively quiet, calculating, and soft-spoken demon, differing himself from the more ubiquitous loud, bloodthirsty, and aggressive kind. Rather than screaming or roaring when annoyed, Kyogai quietly murmured about whatever was irritating him. He believed it was rude for people to barge into his home and would destroy them for getting in his way. If irritated enough, Kyogai raised his voice about the nuisance and insulted his opponents.

Upon first becoming a demon, Kyogai believed Muzan's blood would make him infinitely stronger. However, when his strength became finite after growing unable to get stronger from eating humans, Kyogai was cast out by his master. Desperate to please Muzan and prove the worth of his Blood Demon Art, Kyogai became obsessed with consuming "marechi", humans with rare blood.

entities.name: Kyogo Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Kyogo was shown to be an incredibly tall man, even compared to Sanemi, who himself is noted to be a physically imposing individual. He has short jet black hair and a large scar over his left cheekbone. He possessed a large and muscular frame. Kyogo also had thin, almond-shaped eyes, a trait also seen in his children.

Kyogo wears a kimono with lavender and black irregular concave hexagons as its pattern, over a white juban.

Kyogo was a cruel, aggressive, and confrontational man. He would mercilessly beat his wife and kids, using his superior physical might to abuse his much weaker family, seemingly for no reason. Genya's description of him as pathetic implies that Kyogo would always be looking for a way to hurt people. His harsh and violent personality also put him on the wrong side of other people, which would eventually lead to his death.

Even when his spirit met with Sanemi's in the afterlife, as the latter was close to death, his personality stayed mostly the same. He callously denied Sanemi and Shizu's reunion, claiming that she was coming with him and forcing Sanemi away from the afterlife to regain consciousness, implying that in addition to abusing his wife, he was possessive over her. However, he had some pride in passing on his genetic physical strength to his child, asking him to be proud of being his son as Sanemi would eventually survive the horrific wounds he had suffered in his battles and recover.

entities.name: Makio
entities.description:
Makio is a young woman of average height with a curvaceous figure, pale skin, and large light brown eyes framed by prominent eyelashes on both her upper and lower lids. Her thin eyebrows arch downward, giving her a determined and headstrong look. She has black hair tied up, with yellow bangs framing her face in loose, soft strands.

Makio is seen wearing a red, sleeveless, striped dress that ends mid-thigh, which also reveals her cleavage. her outfit is secured with a black obi where she stores her kunai. She wears gray-colored bandages wrapped around her calves and up to her thighs. Her footwear consists of a pair of zōri with red straps. During her time as Daki's captive, she is seen with cuts and bruises across her body.

When retired, Makio wears a more modest version of her usual attire, consisting of a scarlet kimono with darker lines and lifted sleeves, paired with a white yuban underneath that has an open window revealing her mid-chest. The outfit features white straps tied and laced in an X pattern around her shoulders and back, extending down to her ankles for added coverage. A darker grey obi is tied around her waist, secured with a white obijime in the middle. She retains her red-strapped zōri.

Makio is brash, headstrong, and confident in the way she acts and her life as a kunoichi. Out of her co-wives, she tends to have less patience with Suma. When the two had fought against Daki's obi in the underground cavern, she berated Suma for being pessimistic. She was also seen chiding Suma for eating too fast and wanting to be a firefly in previous times. Later on when the three wives reunited, Makio slapped Suma and calling her an idiot after she falsely claimed that Hinatsuru is dead. Another example is when their husband almost succumbed to Gyutaro's poison and Makio yelled at Suma for loudly panicking and crying, interrupting Tengen's last words, and attempted to shove pebbles into her mouth to silence her.

entities.name: Makomo
entities.description:
Makomo was a young girl of short stature and pale skin, who possessed gentle eyes of a deep cyan color, their pupils rectangular and white, that were a notably paler turquoise near the bottom. She had black hair that came down to her shoulders, spiking outwards at the ends, and short micro bangs over her forehead.

Makomo wore a red yukata with a pink and white flower dot pattern, over which she sported a dark-purple sleeveless haori and a paler brown piece of fabric tied around her waist. On her feet, she wore a pair of what appears to be light brown flats with a strap around her ankles. As with the rest of Sakonji Urokodaki's apprentices, Makomo's white warding mask, hand-carved by her master himself, took the shape of a fox's face, her mask specifically was decorated by two blue flowers painted on its left-hand side.

Completely opposing to Sabito's aggressive and firm personality, Makomo was a girl of quiet, patient, and kind nature. She was always helping Tanjiro Kamado by pointing out any mistakes in his technique and correcting any bad habits he had unconsciously developed during his training under Sakonji. Makomo's pet phrase is that she loves Sakonji very much. She was also a somewhat mysterious person, as she always speaks in an abstract and dreamy way without ever giving straight answers to questions about her past.

Makomo and the other spirits of Sakonji's children entrusted Tanjiro with putting their foster-father's mind at ease. She and Sabito watch over their loved ones, including Tanjiro, who helps put their souls to a peaceful rest.

entities.name: Mantis Demon
entities.description:
The |Kamakiri no oni}} is a minor antagonist in the Entertainment District Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was the target of Tanjiro and Nezuko Kamado's first joint mission as Demon Slayers.

The Mantis Demon's appearance was a combination of human and insectoid features. He mostly retained a human form, with a normal human head, torso, and legs. However, his arms were grotesquely transformed, extending into green, insect-like forelegs from the elbows onward, which ended in sharp, serrated appendages. Four protruding, segmented green legs from his back enhanced his insectoid appearance and provided him with extra agility and stability. The demon's black hair contrasted starkly with his pale blue eyes, which featured slit pupils.

Like most demons, the Mantis Demon exhibited both cunning and ferocity. He often employed surprise attacks, launching himself from hidden vantage points, such as the ceiling, to catch his prey off guard. However, he seemed to acknowledge the threat of Demon Slayers in battle; when pressured or outmatched, he did not hesitate to flee.

The exact time and circumstances of his transformation into a demon remain unknown. However, at some point, he began to haunt the mountain shrine and the Demon Slayer Corps was notified of its existence.

entities.name: Masachika Kumeno
entities.description:
Masachika was a young man with an average build and short, spiky black hair. He had noticeably small, rounded eyebrows and two prominent scars on his left cheek. His mouth was usually curved into a happy smile.

Masachika wore the standard Demon Slayer uniform that consisted of a dark gakuran jacket, white belt, and baggy hakama pants tucked into white wraps of cloth around his ankles.

In Kimetsu Gakuen!, his eyes are olive green with white diamond-shaped pupils.

Masachika was a very kind person, befriending Sanemi and even introducing him to someone who could help train him. In stark contrast to Sanemi's ill-tempered and rude behavior, Masachika is also shown to have a jolly and high-spirited personality. He frequently teased Sanemi by inviting him to eat out, imploring him to view him as his big brother, and poking fun at Sanemi's recklessness and cluelessness to romance. Masachika was also very sociable and charismatic, telling Shinobu Kocho a humorous tale about Gyomei Himejima being chased for playing the flute too loud and fondness for cats, and endearing himself to a grumpy old man with his exuberant charm, making the man retell the story of "Yae".

entities.name: Masao Maeda
entities.description:
Masao is a young man of average height. Most of his features are blocked by the head covering and the mask all members of the Kakushi adorn, although he is shown to have green eyes and round, bushy eyebrows. He wears a pair of large round glasses to help him see.

Within the Demon Slayer Corps, Masao has gained a negative reputation for his inappropriate behavior and is widely regarded as a perverted individual. He has earned the derogatory nickname "Scum Glasses" due to his actions, which include creating sexualized uniforms for female Demon Slayers and harassing them.

When questioned about the revealing outfits, Masao would manipulate and gaslight people, convincing them that they are normal and official attire, as he did with Mitsuri Kanroji. He even went as far as to claim that Kagaya Ubuyashiki himself approved of the uniforms, which is both without evidence, and out of character for the kind master. He also denies any allegations of tampering outfits, such as when he was suspected of continually making Kanao Tsuyuri's culotte panties shorter, dismissing the claims as baseless and attributing any perceived changes to the viewer's own lewd perspective.

In moments of confrontation, he would speak rapidly in an attempt to extricate himself from the situation, displaying a deep fear of potential escalation, particularly if Sanemi Shinazugawa is involved. This fear stems from a past incident where Sanemi admonished Masao for his misconduct, causing him to experience intense fear and even wet himself. When Shinobu destroyed the uniform he had made for her, Masao humbly prostrated himself on the ground in a gesture of remorse and apology, although he screamed in anguish at the destruction of his creation.

entities.name: Matazo
entities.description:
Matazo is a relatively tall man of stocky build with short gray hair, and small stubble on his chin. Physically, he appeared to be in his 50s in age, and was generally seen with a kind expression his face.

As a newly transformed demon, Matazo gains two short horns on his forehead, his canines morphed into more prominent fangs, and his nail became pointed talon-like claws. His face appeared more monstrous and feral and his veins became more prominent across his body.

During his daughter’s childhood, Matazo was shown to be a loving, but awkward father to his daughter. This was mainly due to him having difficulty bonding with her after her mother’s death. As shown, Matazo was initially hesitant to train his daughter in hunting due to initially believing that it was not a profession fit for a woman, but eventually gave in when his friends revealed that Yae simply wanted to spend time with him and bond with him through hunting.

After becoming a demon, Matazo was shown to have become extremely feral and had lost nearly all reason and rationality. As shown where he had immediately violently killed his fellow hunters and devoured them. However, despite becoming a near rabid animal, Matazo still retains his strong love for his daughter, as shown where he recognized her after his first frenzy and ran away from her to avoid eating her as well. Later after she tracked him down in the mountain, Matazo was able to say her name as he tried to eat her.

entities.name: Muichiro Tokito
entities.description:
Muichiro is a young boy of fair skin complexion and short stature. He possesses a lean-muscular build that is described to be thinner and smaller than Tanjiro's, but deceptively strong. He has straight waist-length hair, transitioning from raven-black to turquoise. He wears his hair loose with two clumps protruding slightly from each side of his head, a set of marginally shorter hair left down to frame his face, and unruly bangs over his forehead. He also has large, empty-looking turquoise irises with teal centers, making his overall appearence identical to his older twin brother Yuichiro's.

Following his meeting with Tanjiro Kamado and the return of his childhood memories, Muichiro's once empty-looking eyes seem to have a hopeful glimmer; these are accompanied with a more upbeat and cheery expression, reminiscent of his former demeanor before the death of Yuichiro.

Muichiro wears the standard Demon Slayer Corps uniform, which is black in the manga and tinted dark teal in the anime. The uniform includes a button-up jacket with a stand-up collar, featuring gold buttons and the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back of the uniform, with a shirt pocket on the left breast. Beneath the jacket, he wears a white long-sleeved collared undershirt, though not visible. However, unlike the standard shirt-like cuffed sleeves, Muichiro’s uniform has longer, looser sleeves that are more reminiscent of a kimono, adding a flowing, ethereal quality to his appearance. Instead of the typical tattsuke-hakama pants wrapped with kyahan, Muichiro wears his hakama in the umanori style—a more traditional horseback-riding cut, which, combined with his oversized sleeves, gives his entire outfit a loose and oversized silhouette. His uniform is fastened at the waist with a white belt. For footwear, he wears dark teal tabi socks and a pair of white zōri sandals with teal straps.

When Muichiro was young, he wore a sleeveless yukata that was cyan with a mist design, similar to the darker one his brother wore when they were both ten.

entities.name: Mukago
entities.description:
Mukago was a short woman of slight stature. She had very light gray skin, two dark red stripes across her cheeks, sharp pink fingernails, and a pair of white horns protruding from either side of her forehead. Her eyes were a greyish-purple shade with white rings around the sides and dark red sclera, with the kanji for |3=Ka}} and the daiji for |Shi}} etched onto her left eye, signifying her position. She also possessed chin-length white hair with shorter bangs between her horns.

Mukago wore a plain red kimono with a black-and-white fur-lined collar tied up at the back with a large, dark purple bow. She also wore white tabi socks and black zōri shoes that have orange colored straps.

Like most demons, Mukago held great fear and respect for Muzan Kibutsuji. However, out of all the Lower Ranks, she was also shown to be the most cowardly. As stated by Muzan through reading her thoughts, Mukago had no intention of battling the Demon Slayer Corps' Hashira and planned to flee at the mere mention of one, noted to have done so numerous times. When Muzan learned of this, Mukago tried to deny her thoughts in an attempt to appease him.

Following the death of Lower Rank Five, Rui, Mukago is summoned to the Infinity Castle by Nakime. Before she can comprehend her situation, she is immediately taken to a platform with the rest of the Lower Ranks, where she fearfully looked around, joining Rokuro and Kamanue. Before them are Nakime to the side and an unknown female demon. Initially confused, Mukago becomes terrified when the demon commands them to bow down and kneel. She instantly recognizes the demon is Muzan Kibutsuji, who has disguised himself to lower their guard about what he will do.

entities.name: Murata
entities.description:
Murata is a young man of average height and athletic build. He has straight jet-black hair parted down the middle, fair skin, and simple black eyes with rectangular pupils.

Murata wears the standard predominantly black Demon Slayer uniform, consisting of a gakuran jacket with a shirt pocket on the left side of his chest, and tattsuke-hakama pants. As a younger boy during Final Selection, he is shown wearing a light-blue striped yukata.

Murata is a particularly hapless and anxious Demon Slayer with bouts of pessimism. He is easily frightened and exasperated by his surroundings, and when meeting with Tanjiro and Inosuke, he complains about the two being Mizunotos, the lowest rank in the Corps. However, he does have his moments of bravery, as shown by his continuing to fight atop Mount Natagumo even when his squad was being wiped out. Murata has a fragile ego and does not like it when a Demon Slayer of lower rank chastises or insults him, as shown by his squabbles with Inosuke Hashibira and later with Yushiro. In addition, he has a large amount of respect and fear for the Hashira as well, as although he is extremely intimidated by them, he commends their strength.

He is aware of his low rank and relative weakness, as shown when he recognizes the large power gap between him and Giyu Tomioka despite being in the same Final Selection batch. Moreover, several voice lines in the game hint at his insecurity and acknowledgment of his ineptitude. During his PVP victories, he remarks happiness and disbelief at his growing strength, and his Ultimate Art has him remind his opponent not to forget that he is also a Demon Slayer.

entities.name: Nagakura
entities.description:
Nagakura is a male with a trimmed buzz cut, a noticeably round nose and eyelids that are always shut. He wears the standard Demon Slayer uniform uniform and has a pale complexion.

Not much is known about his personality, but he is impressed by the Hashira's skills. He is also shown to express a sense of camaraderie and cared for his fellow Demon Slayers, as seen when he risked his life to protect Tanjiro Kamado from Muzan's attack.

At a point in his life, Nagakura joined the Demon Slayer Corps.

Nagakura is first seen undergoing Gyomei Himejima's muscle amplification training while enduring a waterfall with Inosuke Hashibira, Yoshioka, and Shimamoto. He is later seen eating and conversing with Murata and Tanjiro while eating fish. He concurs with Murata, Noguchi, Yoshioka, and Shimamoto with the sentiment that the reason the current Hashira have no Tsuguko is because they all became frightened by the laborious training. Nevertheless, he enjoys and compliments Tanjiro's cooking, and is even moved to tears by his grilled onigiri.

entities.name: Naho Takada
entities.description:
Naho is a light-skinned, young girl with black button-like eyes. Her black hair is parted in the middle with two braided twin tails tied with pale green butterfly clips.

Naho wears a long-sleeved, white nurse uniform with a bright green wrap tied into a bow around her waist. She wears white socks and sandals with bright green straps.

Similar to the other members of the trio, Naho is very bright, cheery, and helpful, despite the fact that her family was killed by demons.

After her family had been attacked by demons, Naho was taken in by the Butterfly Mansion by Kanae and Shinobu Kocho, along with Kiyo, Sumi and Aoi.

entities.name: Nakime
entities.description:
Some time after Hantengu's death during the battle in the Swordsmith Village, Nakime attains the position of の|Jōgen no Shi}} in the Twelve Kizuki.

Nakime was a pale woman with a gray complexion, sharp, blue-stained nails, and notably dark pink lips which sharply contrasted the tone of her skin. She had glossy, hip-length hair of a black color, which she wore falling down her back in slight waves that cut off sharply at the ends, with two chin-length strands left to frame her face and long bangs that obscured her large eye set in between them, swept to either side of her nose.

Nakime donned a plain-loose black kimono with a white loose yuban underneath, secured with a striped pale brown-striped obi, white socks, and no shoes or clogs. She was always seen holding a four-stringed wooden biwa with a large bachi pick.

Since becoming an Upper Rank, Nakime took to wearing her bangs as to not obscure her face, showing that she possessed a single large, pink-colored eye with the daiji for |Shi}} engraved into its iris. The upper portion of her face was also revealed, and appeared to be a darker gray color than the rest of her pale skin with prominent veins surrounding her one eye. In addition, her hair would grow extensively and resembles roots on a nearby wall.

entities.name: Nichika Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
Nichika was a girl who had a pale skin complexion, and large, purple eyes. She wore her short, white hair in a blunt bob with a fringe.

Much like her twin sister Hinaki, Nichika wore a dark blue Hōmongi kimono with purple flowers as its pattern and a maroon obi with a cream yellow obiage and juban under everything. On the left side of her head, she donned a chartreuse ribbon opposed to Hinaki, who wore her ribbon on the right side of her head.

Not much was known about her personality, but she does show a sense of loyalty for dying along with her twin sister when their father sacrificed himself to defeat Muzan. Kiriya describes his sister as more skilled than him. Nichika also showed concern over Muichiro's well-being when he began to train intensely despite having barely recovered from his injuries. However, Amane prevented her from interfering with Muichiro's training.

During her final moments, she showed no fear towards Muzan Kibutsuji intruding upon their home; she simply played and sung with her sister, accepting their demise.

entities.name: Noguchi
entities.description:
Noguchi is a male with a long bob haircut, green eyes, and an X-shaped scar on his right shoulder. He has a peachy complexion and wears the standard Demon Slayer uniform.

Not much is known about his personality, but he is impressed by the Hashira's skills, although intimidated by their strength and believes that their intensity scares off any Tsuguko. Noguchi is also shown to take his duties seriously, as he and Shimamoto help kill a giant demon in the Infinity Castle in order to protect the Hashira and conserve their energy to take on Muzan.

At a point in his life, Noguchi joined the Demon Slayer Corps and passed the Final Selection.

Noguchi is first seen undergoing Serpent Hashira Obanai Iguro's sword skill revision training. He had failed to meet the harsh Serpent Hashira's expectations and as punishment was tied up to a podium and was made to be an obstacle to avoid being hit. At some point, he was presumably let down and trained as well, leaving him but a bunch of bruises.

Obanai is a young man of short stature, pale skin complexion, and a lean, muscular build. He has straight-edged, raven-black hair of varying lengths, with the longest reaching down to his shoulders, while the shortest stop at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. His eyes are almond-shaped and tilted upwards on the far sides, and are uniquely colored due to Obanai possessing heterochromia. His right eye is yellow with a black pupil, while his left eye is teal, with the lower rim of the iris being a lighter shade. He is partially blind, barely being able to see out of his right eye.

Obanai's mouth is usually hidden with white bandages over his lower face to hide his large facial scars, which were the result of his family horrifically cutting open his mouth to resemble that of a snake's gape.

Obanai wears the standard Demon Slayer Corps uniform, which is black in the manga and tinted a deep koamaru color in the anime. The uniform consists of a button-up jacket, a stand-up collar and long sleeves, adorned with gold buttons, a shirt pocket on the left breast, and the kanji for |Metsu}} engraved on the back. Beneath the jacket, he wears a white long-sleeved collared undershirt. The uniform is fastened at the waist with a white belt and paired with traditional tattsuke-hakama pants in the same koamaru hue. Over his uniform, Obanai wears his signature black-and-white vertically striped haori, with the hem and cuffs are striped horizontal ways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. For legwear, instead of the standard kyahan, Obanai wraps his lower legs in white bandages, giving the visual impression of traditional kyahan wraps. He also wears another set of white bandages around his lower face. His footwear consists of white zōri sandals with purple-blue straps, worn over koamaru-colored tabi socks to match the color tint of his uniform. He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.
