entities.name: Omitsu
entities.description:
Omitsu was a middle-aged woman with noticeable wrinkles on her face and sharp eyes. Her black hair was tied up in a type of tsubushi shimada style held with a decorative comb.

Omitsu was seen wearing a patterned kimono tied with a light-colored obi.

Omitsu was an esteemed figure in the brothel, evident by the number of people that mourned her passing in the days after she was discovered dead.

Omitsu initially respected Warabihime, as shown when she first ignored the incidents revolving around her. However, that respect eventually evaporated over time and ultimately led her to confront Warabihime in an attempt to protect her remaining staff from further harm.

entities.name: Ozaki
entities.description:
Ozaki was a plain-looking young girl with wide, dark brown eyes that faded to a lighter color at the bottom with white, rectangular-shaped pupils in the center. She had shoulder-length black hair that she wore tied up in a mid ponytail, with some shorter bangs left hanging over her face.

She wore the standard Demon Slayer uniform, consisting of a gakuran jacket with a shirt pocket on the left breast and tattsuke-hakama pants.

Despite her short presence, it was presently obvious that she was a very kind and selfless girl. She warned her fellow Demon Slayers to not approach her since she would just end up unintentionally hurting them, begging them to summon someone of higher rank, not just for her, but for the other captured Demon Slayers.

Ozaki was first seen encountering Tanjiro Kamado and Inosuke Hashibira on Mount Natagumo, where she was being forcibly controlled by Mother of the Spider Family to kill her own comrades. After seeing this happen, Ozaki was horrified, but could do nothing to deal with Mother, since she was attached through some of Mother's strongest threads. She then warned Tanjiro and Inosuke not to come near her and to call the higher ups for backup against the family of demons. Ozaki was then recklessly thrown towards Tanjiro, made to attack him by the Spider Demon, who forced her body to perform moves it physically could not, breaking her arms at their joints in doing so.

entities.name: Rei
entities.description:
Rei was a youthful woman of average build and height. She had fair skin, dark-colored hair styled in a neat bun, and large dark-brown eyes. Though not specified, her age appeared to be similar to her husband's.

She wore a powder blue and white dress, accompanied by a white cloche hat adorned with a pink flower, as well as ornate blue earrings.

Rei was a kind and loving individual, evident in the way she expresses her affection towards both her daughter and husband. She lived her life not knowing about Tsukihiko's true identity as a vile and horrendous monster only passing himself off as human as a disguise.

Because she and her daughter are blissfully unaware about the ancient warring state between Demon Slayers and demons, her reaction to seeing Tanjiro Kamado had led her to become confused at first, due to the latter's confrontational behavior and his strange attire. However, as soon as when she and her daughter had witnessed a demon attack, a diversion that Muzan created to get himself away from an infuriated Tanjiro, they became frightened.

entities.name: Rokuro
entities.description:
Rokuro had the appearance of an older man with a stocky build. He possessed pale skin that was decorated with black, vein-like patterns down his face, arms, and legs. He had long, dark purple hair that he let down, and a short, jagged beard around his jawline. His eyes were golden and cat-like, with the kanji for |3=Ka}} and the daiji for |Ni}} etched onto his left eye, signifying his position.

He wore what appeared to be a dark cyan version of a typical karate gi.

As with most demons, Rokuro greatly respected and feared Muzan Kibutsuji, his leader. After almost every Lower Ranks had been killed by the Demon King, Rokuro was visibly scared that the same would happen to him. Subsequently, he resorted to begging his leader for more blood to increase his strength so he wouldn’t die, showing quite a cowardly demeanor. In spite of this, Rokuro appeared to be very confident in the potential of his abilities as a demon. He claimed that if he received just a little more of Muzan's blood, he could definitely become a strong fighter worthy of being in the ranks of the Twelve Kizuki. This demonstrated his great resolve and passion for his role.

Following the death of Rui, Lower Rank Five, Rokuro is summoned to the Infinity Castle by Nakime. He is one of the two to first appear, along with Enmu. As he looks about at the strange place he was in, he is suddenly transported to a platform at the center, looking around for any clue to his situation. Before them are two demons, Nakime and a female stranger. Confused about and wondering who she may be, he becomes frightened when the demon commands them to crouch down and kneel in a familiar, threatening voice.

entities.description:
Like the rest of his family, Rokuta had light skin and eyes with white pupils. The upper part of his irises was black, while the lower ones were dark red. He wore his black hair in a bowl-cut. Rokuta wore a blue kimono with white diamond patterns, checkered pants, and white socks.

While not much of his personality is known other than him acting like a typical toddler, Rokuta seemed to have a good relationship with his parents and siblings.

Rokuta grew up on a mountain alongside his older siblings and mother. He was the youngest son of the Kamado family.

It appeared that Rokuta had a positive relationship with his father, as Nezuko mentioned him to be lonely and clingy to Tanjiro after their father's death.

entities.name: Rui
entities.description:
Rui was a boy of short stature and small physical build. His skin was solid white, with red dots appearing at several spots on his face, located above his eyes where his eyebrows are supposed to be, below his left eyelid, ending above his nose, and finally a vertical one running the length of his right cheek. His hair was white and bore resemblance to spider legs. The sclera of his eyes was dark red, while his irises were white, having teal colored eyelashes. Due to holding the position of Lower Rank Five, Rui had the kanji of |Ka}} and daiji for |Go}} engraved into his left eye, signifying his ranking. His right eye on the other hand had three pupils, with one large one in the center, and two smaller ones to the right and left of the center pupil.

He wore a white, oversized kimono that had spider webs etched on the sleeves and the expanse of the hem, which also possessed a loose collar, decorated with the same dot-like markings as his face, and a dark red obi belt around his waist. He also wore a plain, white juban underneath, and was barefoot. His nails bore the same color of his eyelashes.

As a human, he possessed normal black hair styled with the same spider-like hairstyle, as well as bright blue eyes. He heavily resembled his human father. He wore the same white kimono, albeit without the spider web pattern, and paired it with a dull brown haori and a pair of wooden sandals. When he first transformed into a demon, both his eyes had three pupils due to not yet joining the Twelve Kizuki, and he had white eyebrows instead of the dot markings he had in the present. By the time he recruited Daughter, he looked identical to his current appearance, although he still did not have the spider web pattern on his kimono.

Rui was a quasi-calm, aloof, and somewhat polite individual, rarely raising his voice, and talking to anyone, demon or Demon Slayer, with a reasonable tone and vocabulary, though his low and guttural way of speaking seems to imply repressed anger and annoyance. Every time he spoke with Tanjiro Kamado during their initial duel, he remained somewhat civil in speech.

entities.name: Ruka Rengoku
entities.description:
Ruka was a young woman with defined facial features, such as her sharp nose, long eyebrows, and pale complexion. She had large dark red eyes with circular white pupils, similar in appearance to the Kamado family, and a small mouth, with semi-long black hair tied loosely at the end in a ponytail.

Ruka was seen wearing a white kimono with blue and aqua colored flowers, secured with a darker-and-light blue obi around her waist.

As opposed to her husband Shinjuro's loud and brash personality, Ruka was depicted as being wise, gentle and graceful. She had strong morals, teaching Kyojuro the importance of his life and the need to use his strength in order to protect the weak and helpless people in the world as his primal duty. Her husband speculated that their two sons have wonderful personalities mainly because of her influence before she passed away, musing both boys were more like her than like him despite physical appearances.

Ruka was the mother of both Senjuro and Kyojuro, and the wife of Shinjuro. Sometime after giving birth to Senjuro, she developed an untreatable disease and was left bedridden up until her death. Before she died, she instilled a moral code within Kyojuro to use his strength to help the weak, a lesson he took to heart until his own death. She was sorely grieved by Shinjuro, who became an alcoholic to drown his sorrows and pain and left his position as the Flame Hashira shortly afterwards.

entities.name: Sabito
entities.description:
Sabito was a fair-skinned teenage boy with a large scar running from the right corner of his mouth to his right ear, and kind, cat-like eyes of a grayish lavender color, a horizontal bar of much paler purple visible across them near the bottom. He had thick, spiked, peach-colored hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching his shoulders, that he wore messily down with side micro bangs over the left of his forehead.

Sabito wore a green kimono, patterned with a geometric hexagon design of yellow and a darker green, tied off at the waist with a piece of black fabric, below which he sported a pair of tattsuke-hakama pants and over which a plain white haori. Around his calves, he wore a pair of kyahan, that bore the same design as his kimono, which his pants were tucked into, as well as black tabi socks and a pair of zōri with red straps on his feet. As with the rest of Sakonji Urokodaki's apprentices, Sabito's white warding mask, hand-carved by his master himself, took the shape of a fox's face, his decorated by a large scar in the same place as the one on his face. The mask's eyes and nose were of a dark green while the ears were more of a gray-red, and it was secured around his face by a thick piece of red rope around his head, the ends of which hung down from behind each of his ears.

Sabito was a serious young boy who believed that all of his actions should be becoming of a man. He was seen as a ruthless mentor during his time training Tanjiro Kamado, who was always quick to point out his flaws and refused to acknowledge him as a man. When asked about defeating the Hand Demon, Sabito appeared to have a pessimistic view on conflicts, saying he believed that no matter how hard someone tries it will never be enough to take the beast down.

Even so, Sabito entrusted his will to Tanjiro and was happy when he surpassed him as Sakonji's strongest student, openly acknowledging that Tanjiro was the toughest of them all and proudly leaving the lingering will of all Sakonji's lost children to him.

entities.description:
Saburo was a middle-aged man of average stature. He was partially bald, with his messy black hair thinning at the front. He had sharp brown eyes and a pointed chin. He wore an expression that showed his fears about demons, appearing anxious and serious when meeting with Tanjiro.

Saburo wore a simple gray yukata, and an olive drab haori on top. He had baggy light-green pants, black socks, and green sandals.

Saburo possesses sharp discernment. He also displays sincerity towards young Tanjiro, willing to offer him his own house to take a rest in for a night due to his beliefs of man-eating demons coming out during the night, and it would be unsafe for travel. His knowledge about Demon Slayers and demons made him more aware and anxious than the average person, which was also due to his family's death because of them.

In the past, Saburo lost his family due to an attack by demons. As a result, he lived in fear of the night and stayed indoors. Consequently, he was also aware of the existence of the Demon Slayer Corps.

entities.name: Sanehiro Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Sanehiro greatly resembles his ancestor Sanemi, possessing his spiky white hair and large, pale purple eyes. He has several scars after arresting someone who was wielding a knife.

He wears a blue police officer uniform and cap with a circular golden pendent on the front.

Sanehiro is shown to take after his ancestor Sanemi in personality, being rather abrasive, hot-blooded, and stubborn, often times impulsive and quick to lash out. He immediately chased after Sumihiko Kamado after he jumped over his police car and demanded he stopped running, visibly angered at his actions. Evidently tired of receiving police reports about him, he did not hesitate to chase Sumihiko to his school and speak with his principal.

Sanehiro was patrolling the streets in a police car with his subordinate, who resembles Genya Shinazugawa. At a traffic light that had just turned green, they encounter Sumihiko Kamado who is rushing to school and had witnessed his attempt to jump over the hood of their police car to avoid having to stop. This action startles both Sanehiro and his partner inside the car. Sanehiro is incensed and believes that Sumihiko must be the one they had received seven reports of.

entities.description:
Satoko was a young girl with black hair, parted at her forehead with short bangs framing her face. Her hair was partially tied with a large, dark pink ribbon on the back of her head.

Satoko wore a magenta-and-white-patterned kimono tied with a mauve-colored obi and zōri. Before she was kidnapped, she was seen carrying a decorated pouch.

Not much is known about Satoko's personality, but it appears she had a cheerful attitude seen when she pleasantly laughed while talking with her fiancé.

At some point in her life, Satoko met and became engaged to Kazumi.

entities.name: Sayo
entities.description:
Sayo has black, short hair styled in a blunt bob with a fringe. During her time at the temple, she typically adorned herself in a traditional light-pink kimono embellished with delicate floral patterns. Like the older children, she did not wear any shoes.

Not much is known about Sayo, other than that she likely behaved like a typical toddler. However, she was shown to be particularly selfless and kind as shown when she offers Gyomei her fish dinner after seeing that the monk himself was not eating, worriedly pointing out his thin physique. In the present, Sayo gained the maturity to retroactively realize her disjointed testimony led to Gyomei's arrest, and that caused her to regret her words.

After losing her parents at a tender age, Sayo found herself in the care of Gyomei within the sanctuary of a temple. There, she was embraced by a new family, comprising eight other orphaned children, who became her steadfast companions. Bound not by blood but by shared experiences and a sense of belonging, they forged a deep and unbreakable bond.

In a moment that would forever haunt her, a night of tragedy unfolded within the temple. Sayo was four years old at the time when the harmony of their sanctuary was shattered by an act of disobedience; Kaigaku, one of the children, ventured outside the temple at night and met a demon, and in a desperate bid to save himself, he betrayed his companions. As everyone slept, the child extinguished the protective Wisteria incense and invited the demon inside. Four children immediately fell victim to the demon's relentless assault, while the remaining ones defied Gyomei's orders and were killed while they fled.

entities.name: Senjuro Rengoku
entities.description:
Senjuro is a boy with fair skin, bushy black eyebrows, and large, gold eyes that redden near his white pupils, that are slanted inwards and shaped so as to give him a determined yet kind appearance. Senjuro has a similar appearance to his brother, Kyojuro Rengoku, and father, Shinjuro Rengoku, possessing unruly golden hair that flares out around his face, becoming red near the ends above his ears and shoulders, that he wears messily tied back behind his head.

Senjuro wears a plain white yukata and juban with darker umanori-styled hakama pants, secured with a red obi sash. In Kyojuro Rengoku's memory dream in the Mugen Train, he wore a dark haori above his white yukata.

Senjuro is originally seen to be very sad and rattled by his brother's death and his father's verbal abuse, but, after spending some time talking to Tanjiro Kamado, his true personality as a kind, caring individual who can usually see the best in a situation or person shines through. He has hope for his future, and even though he knows that by not becoming a Demon Slayer he has broken his family's ancient tradition, he knows that his older brother, Kyojuro, would forgive him for leaving such a scar on their history.

It's noted that, at some point in his life, Senjuro was to become Kyojuro's successor and so had been training to become a Demon Slayer. However, due to his lack of skill in the field, Senjuro had to give up on that dream and decided to spend his life helping people in other ways.

entities.name: Senri Ubuyashiki
entities.description:
As a child, Senri looked identical to his brothers, with the only differences being a different colored kimono and his bangs being parted down the middle. In addition, he was shown to wear an angered glare and had bags under his eyes, reflecting his resentful personality.

Unlike the kind and understanding Kagaya or meek and docile Akito, Senri was volatile and resentful, intensely loathing his family curse giving him a shortened life. He also hated his family's custom of donning female attire to stave off the curse, possibly out of a feeling of emasculation. Senri's hatred of his cursed life worsened when his father committed suicide, and he eventually would retaliate by setting his home on fire to commit suicide himself, taking his younger brother in doing so.

Senri was the middle child of his generation of the Ubuyashiki family. He lamented his short life span and refused to wear female clothing, as was tradition in the Ubuyashiki family to stall the familiar curse. He also gradually lost his mental balance from fear. After the suicide of his father, he spent his days cursing his mother and older brother. Eventually, Senri took his younger brother, Akito, to set fire to the mansion, and forced him to commit double suicide. Their mother would die from the fire in an attempt to save them, leaving Kagaya to be the sole survivor.

entities.name: Serpent Demon
entities.description:
The |Hebi oni}} was a demon that was worshipped by Obanai Iguro's clan.

The Serpent Demon had long black, layered hair that reached past her shoulders, yellow eyes with thin slitted pupils similar to a snake, a wide fanged mouth stretching from ear to ear, and vein-like patterns around her eyes. She had a wide mouth that reached her ears, which revealed her small, sharp fangs. Her long tongue was forked at the end. and she had sharp, bright green nails on her hands. Her upper torso had three violet lines alongside the oblique of her chest. The lower half of her body was that of a traditional snake, with an elongated, legless body covered in brown scales and a grayish yellow-colored stomach.

The Serpent Demon wore nothing but a gold necklace imbedded with various jewels and four larges pearls.

As with most demons, the Serpent Demon was extremely cruel and murderous towards humans. Notably, she had a disturbing preference towards eating children, especially infants, and requested them regularly as her favorite meal. Her sadistic pleasure in her choice of prey was also reflected when she deemed Obanai as something worthy to satisfy her, ordering that he be allowed to grow up before she could eat him, even having his mouth sliced open to look like her.

entities.name: Shigeru Kamado
entities.description:
Shigeru was a young boy with a light complexion. Like the rest of his family, Shigeru had white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and dark red at the bottom. His black hair was worn as a buzz cut.

Shigeru wore a light green and black-patterned kimono with a light green haori over it. He also sported a white nagajuban under everything.

Shigeru appearef to be very fond of his brother Tanjiro, wanting to follow him wherever he goes and do whatever he does. Like his siblings, he was upset when Tanjiro and his mother told him he could not go to town with him.

Shigeru grew up on a mountain alongside his siblings and mother. He is the second youngest son of the Kamado family.

entities.name: Shimamoto
entities.description:
Shimamoto is a male with short, messy, spiky black hair and gray pupils. He wears the standard Demon Slayer uniform and has a pale complexion, along with an X-shaped scar on the right side of his face.

Not much is known about his personality, but he is impressed by the Hashira's skills, although intimidated by their strength and believes that their intensity scares off any Tsuguko. Shimamoto is also shown to take his duties seriously, as he and Noguchi help kill a giant demon in the Infinity Castle in order to protect the Hashira and conserve their energy to take on Muzan.

At a point in his life, Shimamoto joined the Demon Slayer Corps.

Shimamoto is first seen undergoing Gyomei Himejima's muscle amplification training while enduring a waterfall with Inosuke Hashibira, Nagakura, and Yoshioka. He is later seen eating and conversing with Murata and Tanjiro while eating onigiri. He concurs with Murata, Noguchi, Nagakura, and Yoshioka with the sentiment that the reason the current Hashira have no Tsuguko is because they all became frightened by the laborious training. Nevertheless, he enjoys and compliments Tanjiro's cooking, and is even moved to tears by his grilled onigiri.

entities.name: Shinjuro Rengoku
entities.description:
Shinjuro is a tall man with a muscular build, fair skin, bushy black eyebrows. He has bright orange eyes that redden near his white pupils. His eyes are slanted inwards and shaped to give him a furious appearance. He possessing unruly orange hair that flares out around his face, becoming redder near the ends above his ears, that he wears messily tied back behind his head. When he was younger and a more active father, Shinjuro notably cut his hair much shorter. Shinjuro strongly resembled his two sons, Kyojuro and Senjuro in terms of appearances. In fact, despite his gruffer and aged appearance, Shinjuro's resemblance to his elder son was so strong that Kyojuro was mistaken for his father on two separate occasions.

Shinjuro wears a dark grey kimono robe that fades to darker blue from the top, tied with a black obi, and wearing pair of [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Z%C5%8Dri zori]. When Kyojuro informed him of his promotion to Hashira, he wore a beige kimono. In the Infinity Castle Arc, he is shown with a katana with a flame guard similar to Kyojuro's, with what appears to be a flame pattern on the sheath.

When he was the Flame Hashira, Shinjuro donned a brick-colored kimono, dark tattsuke-hakama pants, and a pair of red kyahan decorated with yellow flame motifs. He also wore the haori with flame-like ridges at the end that Kyojuro wore when he was the Flame Hashira.

Shinjuro was a very short-tempered man, especially when regarding the Demon Slayer Corps and his son, Kyojuro, with the mention of either causing him to grow furious. He appeared to be abusive, harshly insulting the recently deceased Kyojuro and knocking Senjuro to the ground during his fight with Tanjiro. He is also an alcoholic - his first action upon awakening after being knocked out by Tanjiro is to buy alcohol, and he is often seen drinking with sake. In fact, it's possible that the worst of Shinjuro's abuse was due to his inebriation.

entities.name: Shizu Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Shizu was a petite woman with a small and dainty frame. Her black hair was fastened in a low bun with her bangs clipped back on the crown of her head. She also had a very small face with large blue round eyes. Shizu wore a white juban underneath her horizontally stripped yellow kimono, and had a black obi tied around her waist.

As a demon, she possessed noticeable fangs and sharpened nails, but otherwise appeared the same as whilst she was human except for her hair being down.

Shizu was described as a hard worker who would work from "morning until night" and hardly slept. Despite being in an abusive marriage, and having a small frame, she would always shield her children from her husband Kyogo's abuse and was considered a "hero" to them.

In the afterlife, even when she was unable to control herself as a demon, Shizu could not stand to be with the children she unwillingly killed and reserved herself to her fate in Hell, though she seemed appreciative when Sanemi did not hesitate to go with her.

entities.name: Shoichi
entities.description:
Shoichi is a short young boy of around 8-10, with black spiky hair and hazel eyes with a thick black border, a trait shared by both his siblings.

Shoichi wears a blue haori over a light green iromuji kimono with a white juban under it.

While his personality is not fully elaborated on, one can assume he is a loyal brother as he decides to follow his older brother to rescue him after he was kidnapped by a demon. He has also shown a protective side while interacting with his younger sister. It can be surmised that Shoichi is braver than average, as he decides to follow the two Demon Slayers, Tanjiro and Zenitsu, into the Tsuzumi mansion. Even when separated from the others with Zenitsu, he shows more courage than the Thunder Breathing user.

While not much is known about his personal history, Shoichi came from a family of presumably three kids, with him being the middle child.

entities.name: Shuya Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Shuya was a young boy of small stature and fair skin tone. His dark hair was shaved down and he had large purple almond-shaped eyes. He bore a resemblance with his two oldest brothers Sanemi and Genya.

Shuya wore a tan colored kimono with a two-tone black and light brown obi.

Shuya, like his siblings, was a warm and caring child. He loved his mother dearly, who, in return, would often protect him from his father's abuse on multiple occasions. When he awoke to find she had not come home late at night, he waited till she came home and eagerly ran to greet her at the door when Shizu did arrive, though it would sadly cost him his life.

Shuya was born to Shizu and Kyogo Shinazugawa and was raised with six other siblings. His abusive father would often beat his family, though he was constantly protected by his mother from his outbursts. Eventually, Kyogo would die to a vengeful stabbing and the family would be at peace.

entities.name: Slasher
entities.description:
Slasher was a bald, middle-aged man of muscular build and very pale skin of a light greenish-gray shade. His eyes had lime-green irises, black scleras, and vertical slits for pupils. He had dark blue, sharp-pointed nails and prominent fangs. Most notably, Slasher's whole body was covered in dark blue tattoos, running across various places such as his face, limbs and torso. These tattoos lighted up and glowed blue when his Blood Demon Art was used. He also wore a sleeveless blue shirt and black leggings, complete with tabi socks and a pair of zōri with blue straps. Slasher was usually seen with a maniacal expression on his face.

Like most demons, Slasher was a ruthless individual that seemed to care merely about murdering and eating humans. He displayed a sadistic and malicious side, off-handedly mentioning how he slashed a woman until he became bored and when he dug his claws into a young boy. Slasher was also shown to be quite arrogant at times, looking down on the Flame Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, boasting his speed in front of him, and challenging him to a duel twice. However, Slasher was not above using underhanded tactics like taking a hostage to win against Kyojuro.

Slasher was also rather petty, trying to find whatever means to provoke Kyojuro and growing further frustrated and more aggressive when the young man both held his ground, retorted back and even stopped his attacks.

The marked demon encounters and terrorizes a village in search of prey, and his murders are reported by the press and the locals, who refer to him as "The Slasher". One night, he finds a young woman roaming around at night but thought she does not seem worth eating. Instead, he horrifically claws her body till he becomes bored and leaves her to die. The next night, he boards a train but found it empty, apart from one hapless train conductor. He quickly kills him, but finds him not worthy of devouring and leaves his body to be discovered. The news of his actions frightens the village and people fear leaving their houses after dark, causing business usually active at night to halt. The Demon Slayer Corps subsequently sends Kyojuro Rengoku to investigate.

entities.name: Spider Demon
entities.description:
The 「」|Kumo oni: Ane}} is a supporting antagonist in the Mount Natagumo Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. She was a member of the Spider Family.

Daughter appeared as a girl of slight build in her early teens. Her most notable traits were the spider-like features she shared with her "family". She had snowy white, pale skin, and a small, sharp-featured, white face patterned by red dots. Her eyes are white, and her silvery eyeballs distinguish them from her white sclera, fringed by pale teal-colored lashes. She also had long, snowy white hair tied into two loose tails, resting above each shoulder. They are tied by ribbons decorated by a large turquoise/teal bead each. She usually wore an aloof expression on her face. Daughter's clothing consisted of a long white kimono and a dark blue hexagon-patterned juban underneath. She wore ribbons in her hair that were decorated with a large blue bead, and unlike her other "family members", who were barefoot, she wore black slippers.

Daughter's original appearance as a demon was completely different than her current, having morphed and changed her features due to being forced by Rui as a condition to be accepted into his family. Her original appearance was that of a teen demon with black hair, slitted cat-like eyes, and pale grayish skin. Her attire consisted of a long olive green kimono with a pink obi and a white juban underneath. In addition, she wore a pair of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zori zōri] sandals that had red straps.

Daughter is shown to be the most cautious within her "family," having instead opted to observe and stand back rather than jump right into the battle against Demon Slayers. She is also shown to be very cowardly, both with battling against the Demon Slayer Corps and dealing with her family's internal conflict. When her "mother" was being violently abused and reprimanded by Rui and her "father," she stood back and gave her the same severe glare due to her weakness instead of helping her. She again shows her cowardice by trying to convince Rui to run instead of fighting after most of their family was defeated, which enrages him and leads him to wound her.

entities.name: Spider Demon
entities.description:
Physically, Father was the most formidable of his "family", possessing great height and a powerfully built physique. His skin was dark brown with the same red, dot-like design his family members possess. It extended from his shoulders, reaching down to his arms. Like his "wife" and "children," Father also had white hair reminiscent of Rui, although his was much longer, reaching down across his shoulders. His most unique trait was his monstrous face; unlike his "family's" more humanoid appearance, his face was identical to that of a true spider, with several eyes, large, jagged teeth, with an addition to large pincers for a mouth.

When he molted, he gained green skin with blade-like protrusions sticking out of his arms and legs. He lost all his hair and obtained sharper teeth and more pronounced mandibles. He also gained five spikes going upwards on his forehead. Finally, one of the most notable changes was that the number of his eyes doubled from nine, to eighteen.

Father was animalistic, aggressive, and extremely bloodthirsty. He was shown to be very devoted to his "family", as when he battled Tanjiro Kamado and Inosuke Hashibira, he repeatedly told them to stay away from his family while attempting to kill the duo. He served as the main protector and was seen being on the lookout for the Demon Slayers when they came to Mount Natagumo. However, he was also shown to be very abusive towards his "wife," having repeatedly slashed and physically abused her in the past without even stating his reasons for doing so due to her being weaker than to what they originally expected of her. Father was additionally shown to have been unquestioningly loyal to Rui, having never once challenged or defied him. However, unlike his "wife" and "daughter" who were obedient out of fear, Father seemed to lack the mental capacity to question Rui, who in turn treated him more like a lackey than an actual father.

entities.name: Spider Demon
entities.description:
Mother was very similar in appearance to her "son" Rui, having the same solid white skin, teal eyelashes and nails, and circular, red facial markings. She also possesses a short and curvaceous physique. Additionally, she had bushy eyebrows and long, white hair parted down the middle of her face which was tied with teal orbs into two, thick strands.

Mother wore a lengthy, layered kimono — maroon on the inside layer and white on the outside layer — that exposed part of her chest and was tied with a patterned obi. She also donned a beaded necklace composed of teal and purple orbs and decorative anklets. Like almost every other member of the Spider Family, she also goes barefoot and has black nail polish on her toenails; the lower front of the kimono is open, exposing her legs.

Mother's original appearance before drinking Rui's blood was completely different from her transformed one, with a much smaller, childlike body compared to her new, more voluptuous figure. Her skin was marked with two maroon lines on each of her cheeks and her eyes were rounder with yellow irises and x-shaped pupils. She also wore her short, black hair parted to the side with bangs framing her face and two, low pigtails.

Like most demons, Mother was cruel, unfeeling, and murderous towards humans. She ruthlessly controlled dozens of Demon Slayers through her threads and manipulated them into killing each other. She was also rather sadistic and callous, uncaring that her manipulation brought them prolonged suffering. In spite of this, spending time with Rui's family caused her developed an intense fear for him and Father, both of whom had abused her for being weaker than expected. This abuse was severe enough to make her embrace death instead of having to continue on, knowing that both Rui and Father would continue to torment her.

entities.name: Spider Demon
entities.description:
Son takes the form of a giant spider possessing a human head. His face, like Mother and Daughter, had the same facial features of red dots, white skin and hair similar to his "younger brother" Rui, with the only difference being that his eyes possess dark red scleras, with blue irises and black pupils. In addition, his right eye was wide-eyed with a small iris and miotic pupil, while his left eye was squinted with a large iris and dilated pupil.

Son's spider body was fuzzy like a tarantula and purple with orange stripes on his legs, and orange patterns on his thorax. Son also had a spinnerets which almost always had a thread coming out of them, using it to hang upside down.

Son was shown to be sadistic and cruel, as seen in the flashbacks of Mother's memories when he openly taunted and enjoyed the physical and verbal abuse she was being put through by Rui and Father, while addressing them formally as his parents, showing that he sadistically enjoyed playing the part of being in a "family". Similarly to Father, he was extremely loyal to Rui's cause and played his role as an elder brother in his family without question.

Like most demons, he hated humans; he was responsible for a great number of people transforming into spiders and even ruled over them, making them servants when their mental intellect eventually faded away with their transformation. His taunting and prideful nature was also evident when he continually prodded and mocked Zenitsu Agatsuma over his impending fate as a spider.

entities.name: Suma
entities.description:
Suma is a young woman of short height with pale skin, shoulder-length black hair, short bangs, and blue eyes. Similar to the other wives of Tengen Uzui, she has a voluptuous figure.

Suma wears a short, blue, sleeveless dress that shows both sides of her hips reaching her upper thighs with a plunging white neckline that exposes her cleavage, which is secured with a gray obi (light purple in some promotional art) where she probably stores her [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kunai kunai]. She wears gray ankle-length tabi socks and white zōri with blue straps.

When retired, Suma wears a more modest version of her usual clothes, consisting of a blue kimono with lifted sleeves and a white yuban underneath featuring an open window that reveals her mid-chest. The outfit includes white straps tied and laced in an X pattern around her shoulders and back, providing greater coverage down to her ankles. A lighter blue-grey obi is tied around her waist, secured with a dark grey obijime in the middle. She also wears her hair tied into a ponytail and retains her blue-strapped zōri.

Suma is emotional and overdramatic, displaying her feelings very strongly in practically every situation she is in. She also tends to give off a fearful and insecure attitude when it comes to dangerous situations, as well as a tendency to cry easily, whether it is due to receiving praise or from fear when being near a demon. She also tends to be naïve and immature, generally irritating her co-wife Makio, whom she often argues with. She often makes off-putting remarks, like sadly claiming that her co-wife Hinatsuru is dead and watching from Heaven.

entities.name: Sumi Nakahara
entities.description:
Sumi is a young girl with pale skin and a set of black, button-like eyes. She wears her black hair in two low pigtails fastened with light blue butterfly clips.

Sumi sports a long-sleeved, white nurse uniform tied with a bright blue ribbon around her waist and wears white socks and sandals with bright blue straps.

Like the other members of the trio, Sumi is very bright, cheery, and helpful despite her family was killed by demons. She is portrayed as more polite and mature than what is usually expected for girls her age.

After her family had been attacked by demons, Sumi was taken in by the Butterfly Mansion by Kanae and Shinobu Kocho, along with Kiyo, Naho and Aoi.

entities.name: Sumi Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Sumi was a girl of small frame and light skin tone. She had dark colored hair that was fastened in a low bun with her bangs clipped back on the crown of her head. She also had a very small face with large, blue round eyes. Sumi bore a great resemblance to her mother.

She wore a long light red kimono with an orange obi.

Sumi was a warm and caring child, much like the rest of her siblings. During one of her father's violent outbursts, she blocked her youngest sibling's view in order to prevent him from seeing it. She loved her mother dearly and was worried for her wellbeing when she was late from coming home, noting that she had never done so before.

Strangely enough though, despite her virtuous qualities, her elder brother Genya claims that although she was kind and considerate of their mother, she was also "a spoiled brat". It is unsure if Genya meant this in a tongue-in-cheek way or if Sumi was actually temperamental or coddled as a young child.

entities.name: Sumihiko Kamado
entities.description:
Sumihiko is a young man with short, ruffled black hair with combed back burgundy tips and a few stray tufts falling down over his forehead. He has wide, dark red eyes with white pupils that appear lighter around the lower section of his irises. Overall, his appearance bears a strong resemblance to that of his ancestor Tanjiro Kamado.

Sumihiko wears his high school's uniform, consisting of a pale blue dress shirt with a sleeveless, white v-neck cardigan worn over the top, and plain black pants. He wears a black necktie around his neck, as well as a pair of dark brown dress shoes.

Sumihiko takes after Tanjiro in terms of personality as well as appearance, as he too is kind and cheerful by nature, smiling and talking happily to his friend Tojuro as they run together. He also appears to be rather sleepy, not waking up when Kanata tried to get him up for school and implying he's slept in and been late numerous times, as well as being shown to be yawning on the cover page. He appears to be rather athletic, countering his brother's noted skill in more academic subjects, as he was seen jumping down and off tall buildings and swinging himself from stairwells and railings on his run to school.

Despite being somewhat clumsy, Sumihiko has respect for others, as, when he runs past a pair of older men playing shogi and a group of young girls, he turns back with an apologetic expression and says he is sorry for any disruption he had caused.

entities.name: Sumire Kamado
entities.description:
Sumire was a very young small child, with messy black hair that is tipped with red and tied back with a pink bow. She had large black eyes that fade to pink with white pupils, a trait common among the Kamado family.

She wore a grid-patterned pale purple kimono with a light pink obi and had no footwear.

Sumire was usually happy and cheerful, always shown smiling, as is typical of a toddler. Being very young, she was frequently curious, as shown when she approached Yoriichi talking with her father and later watched him perform the moves of his Sun Breathing. According to Sumiyoshi, Sumire enjoyed being lifted up and she squealed with joy when Yoriichi picked her up, since Yoriichi was much taller than Sumiyoshi. Despite her usual happy and cheery demeanor, she appeared saddened when Yoriichi left them for the last time.

While Sumiyoshi and Sumire stood outside their home, she noticed Yoriichi Tsugikuni nearby standing under a tree and tugged at her father's clothes to inform him. After a long chat, where Yoriichi told Sumiyoshi about his life and his regrets about Muzan's escape, the moment grew gloomy; Yoriichi became despondent after reminiscing on his tragedies and Sumiyoshi could not find ways to cheer him up. At that moment, Sumire appeared. thumb|205x205px|Yoriichi hugging Sumire. Tugging at the Demon Slayer's haori, she asked him to carry her. Yoriichi obliged at his friend's request, noting she enjoyed it greatly. As Yoriichi lifted her up, she became overjoyed. Her laughter caused him to break down in tears and he hugged the little girl. Though somewhat bewildered, Sumire returned the favor and embraced him. Her mother appeared shortly after and cheered Yoriichi up as well.

entities.name: Sumiyoshi Kamado
entities.description:
Sumiyoshi was a man who looked remarkably like an unscarred, older version of Tanjiro Kamado, possessing the same facial structure, eyes, and hair type. However, his hair was longer, about shoulder-length, and worn tied in a ponytail behind his head.

Their similarities continue into his attire, as Sumiyoshi wore a white nagajuban with a short, black-checkered kimono over it of an almost identical design to Tanjiro's usual haori, along with a pair of light tobi pants. He finally sported white zōri with red straps, lacking any tabi socks.

In the short memory piece that Tanjiro received from his ancestor, it is shown that their personalities are very alike. Similar to Tanjiro, Sumiyoshi was shown to be a kind, generous, honest, and humble individual.

Sumiyoshi and his wife Suyako once found an abandoned house in the woods and decided to make it their home. They were attacked by a demon during the last month of her pregnancy when the house's previous tenant, a Demon Slayer, Yoriichi Tsugikuni, saved them. Sumiyoshi was forever grateful of the man's actions and eventually befriended him.200px|left|thumb|Sumiyoshi and Yoriichi. During the birth of his second child, Sumiyoshi had his friend watch over his wife and child as he went away, later apologizing for making a guest run an errand as he brought him some food. Yoriichi did not mind, but intended to leave soon, as he believed eating free meals was impolite; Sumiyoshi reminded him they were indebted to him for his actions, leading their children to be born. He then asked for his name, which he did not disclose, but Yoriichi did not see any value in telling him. He rejects Sumiyoshi's perception of him as special and believes he is a man of no worth.

entities.name: Susamaru
entities.description:
Susamaru was a pale-skinned woman with bright yellow eyes, cat-like slits, and white horizontal slats. She had black hair that transitioned to orange at the tips, styled with short, spiky bangs at the front.

Susamaru wore a pair of long silver earrings and an orange kimono that matched her hair. She had a black haori on top, but took them both off when she entered her battle, revealing a small black sarashi that covers her chest and upper abdomen.

Susamaru was shown to be rather playful, yet very brash and quite immature. She had an almost ceaseless smile, and was someone who always enjoyed and accepted a challenge. Her pet phrase is "what fun this is", something she would repeat constantly if engaged in bouts she deemed amusing. Her immaturity was a stark contrast to Yahaba's seriousness.

She was fanatically loyal to Muzan Kibutsuji and battled to the best of her abilities in the hopes of killing Tanjiro Kamado and taking Tamayo hostage for her master. When the latter denounced Muzan as a manipulative coward, she defended his honour and denied her statements vehemently.

entities.name: Suyako Kamado
entities.description:
Suyako was a petite young woman with long black hair, which appeared to curve in or be tied together below her shoulders, with two ear-length strands handing down on either side of her face. She had wide, black eyes that faded to a pale pink towards the bottom of the irises, (sapphire in the anime), and appeared to always wear a large smile.

Her attire consisted of a plain, pale purple-colored (pink in the anime) kimono and a piece of white cloth that she wore tied around the top of her head.

As seen by Tanjiro Kamado during his flashbacks, Suyako was a happy, hardworking woman who was always doing the best she could for her children. Upon seeing Yoriichi unexpectedly weeping as he hugged Sumire, her caring nature came forward, telling the swordsman she would feed him to cheer him up. Suyako's cheerful nature was also present when she would ask Yoriichi to perform his Sun Breathing forms, causing her to be delighted and fascinated by them.

Not much is known about Suyako, except that she married a man named Sumiyoshi Kamado and gave birth to their son and daughter. She, along with Sumiyoshi, found Yoriichi Tsugikuni and Uta's house at Mount Kumotori long after the latter's death, and decided to move in there.

entities.name: Swamp Demon
entities.description:
The の|Numa no Oni}} is the eponymous main antagonist in the Kidnapper's Bog Arc of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a demon that went on a rash of kidnappings during Tanjiro Kamado's first mission for the Demon Slayer Corps.

The Swamp Demon was a young man with pale skin, long blue hair with two long strands of violet on both sides of his face, supported by two golden hair separators. As usual with demons, he had claw-like nails and the veins on his forehead were quite prominent, in his case, to the point of replacing his eyebrows. His eyes were red without pupils and with prominent dark eye bags. Due to him being able to divide into two demons apart from himself, each demon differed from the other in the number of horns and clothing.

The main body had a single horn in the upper center of its forehead and wore a full-length long-sleeved shinobi uniform with meshes on its wrists and neck, the mesh of the neck having three small ribbons centered hanging from it. There were divisions inside his uniform coat where he could keep the collection of hairpins of his victims.

The second body had two horns, one on each side of its forehead. His shinobi attire did not have sleeves, instead, it had two small triangular meshes in the armpit area and a large triangular mesh on his chest.

entities.name: Takaharu
entities.description:
Takaharu is a young man in his late teens or early to late twenties, he has a shaved head ⁠— similar to the haircut Shigeru has ⁠— and wears a white rope as a headband in the style of hachimaki. He also has distinctly large earlobes, as well as long eyelashes.

In the chapter, he wears baggy light colored trousers beneath a dark jinbei-styled kimono, and can be seen carrying a medium sized razor hoe.

Takaharu has an extremely rambunctious personality and foul mouth due to the manner in which he was raised. When he encounters Inosuke as an infant, he scares him off in a vulgar manner, and calls his grandfather a dumb old man for feeding him, mistaking Inosuke for a weird animal.During their multiple encounters, he constantly scolds his grandfather for continuing to care for Inosuke, but does so in order to protect his aging grandfather. After he realizes that Inosuke can talk, he becomes fearful of him and calls him a monster, ultimately allowing him to do as he pleases in his home.

Not much can be said about Takaharu's history except that he lives with his grandfather and works during the day.

entities.name: Takeo Kamado
entities.description:
Takeo had short, spiky black hair, similar to his older brother Tanjiro and his father. Like the rest of his siblings, Takeo had a pale complexion that contrasted with his white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and dark red at the bottom. His appearance was highly reminiscent of Tanjiro's, except he had a beauty mark beneath his right eye like his mother and lacked the scar on the top of his forehead.

Takeo wore a cloud-gray iromuji-kimono with a sea-green haori on top of it, along with a pair of tobi pants and boots. He also sported a turquoise and black patterned scarf.

Unlike the rest of his family, Takeo appeared more serious and stern, showing his disappointment in not being able to join his older brother when his mother believe he would slow him down. Nonetheless, he cared about his family very much, showing visible dismay at the prospect of Tanjiro suddenly leaving for the town.

As shown by how he viewed his older brother and sister, Takeo was a very thoughtful and loving sibling. He had a tendency to put others first before himself, worrying that his older siblings may end up sacrificing something vital to themselves due to their boundless compassion and selflessness.

entities.name: Takeuchi
entities.description:
Takeuchi is a young man with round black eyes and short, messy, spiky black hair. He has a peachy complexion and wears the standard Demon Slayer uniform.

Takeuchi is very selfless, offering his life to help Yushiro. He cares about his comrades as he performs medical aid to them.

Not much is known about his past, but at a point in his life Takeuchi became a Demon Slayer.

Takeuchi can be seen running with Murata during Tengen Uzui's stamina training. Sometime later, he moved on to Obanai Iguro's sword skill revision training. He had failed to meet the harsh Serpent Hashira's expectations and as punishment was tied up to a podium and was made to be an obstacle to avoid being hit. At some point, he was presumably let down and trained as well, leaving him but a bunch of bruises. When he and some other trainees, including Tanjiro Kamado and Noguchi were about to enter a hot onsen bath, they knew that it was going to agitate their bruises, so they decided to go in simultaneously. They did, but still scream and wince in agony.

entities.name: Tamayo
entities.description:
During the final confrontation between humanity and demons, Tamayo, along with Yushiro, joins forces with the Demon Slayer Corps to develop a drug that would aid in the defeat of Muzan Kibutsuji.

Tamayo is a petite young woman with long, dark brown hair that is parted in the center. She wears it braided back into a large, low bun, which is held in place by a floral tama-kanzashi hairpin. She has large, gentle eyes that initially do not possess pupils, only a haze of lavender that fades to dark purple the higher it goes, and notably red lips in contrast to her pale complexion. She also possesses sharp, polished fingernails. She is noted to have an attractive appearance by Tanjiro and Yushiro.

Tamayo's outfit consists of a dark purple medium-length hōmongi kimono that is decorated with wavy pale purple tree branches and red flowers with green leaves. She also wears a cream-colored taiko musubi obi to secure it around her waist, as well as plain white socks and violet zōri sandals.

During the confrontation between the Demon Slayer Corps and Muzan, Tamayo's eyes are shown to have black cat-like pupils and Yushiro's talisman scattered in her kimono.

entities.name: Tanjuro Kamado
entities.description:
Tanjuro was a frail man with black hair tipped with red, red eyes that shows lighter color at the bottom while appearing more darker at the upper of the irises, and a pale skin complexion. His son Tanjiro has a striking resemblance to him in hair and eye color. He suffered from an illness that made him frail and caused his skin to appear dull. He was born with a mark on his forehead.

Tanjuro also wore a similar outfit to his son, sporting a black checkered Haori that was orange instead of dark turquoise. He wore hanafuda earrings when he was alive; these were passed down from his ancestor, eventually leading Tanjiro to wear them upon his death.

When performing the Kagura ritual dance, Tanjuro took the appearance of an Iwami Kagura dancer with a long sleeved dark brown dress with golden and crimson red frames with a large blindfold covering his entire face with the kanji for inscribed on it. He used a decorated wooden blade akin to a Shichishitō, which bore the appearance of a flaming sword, inspired by Yoriichi's Sun Breathing forms.

Tanjuro was a quiet, calculating, forgiving, charismatic and loving person. He had a peaceful relationship with his family and regularly lectured Tanjiro about life. While he appeared calm on the outside, he showed a decent, noble aura with a quiet perception to his surroundings. According to his son, he did not like standing out or displaying his true abilities to others. However, if his family is in danger, he would not hesitate to protect them and shows no mercy towards the enemy.

entities.name: Taro
entities.description:
Taro was a dog of the Canis genus Shiba Inu breed.

Taro was Yae's dog since her childhood, and seemed very loyal to her. Yae cared deeply about him. Although Taro is nice to people, he also seemed to be somewhat wary of certain strangers, as he bit Giyu Tomioka on the hand when the Hashira tried to pet him.

During Yae's childhood, Taro was adopted by her, becoming a loyal and loving companion to her before his death.

Yae and Taro are met by the Water and Insect Hashira, Giyu Tomioka and Shinobu Kocho. While Yae is with Shinobu after falling unconscious, Giyu is sitting with Taro in another room. As he reaches out to pet Taro; he is bitten on the hand by the dog, causing him to panic and try to shake Taro off. However, Taro refused to let go until Yae calls out to him, instructing him to stop and apologize to Giyu, as he was usually kind with people. He follows her instructions, but remains attached to the Hashira.

entities.name: Tatsu
entities.description:
Tatsu is a minor character in Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a train maintenance worker that was held hostage by the Slasher demon.

Tatsu is a young boy, approximately 15 years old, which is the legal age for employment in Japan. He is of average height with dark brown hair and chocolate brown eyes that appear empty, lacking visible pupils. He typically wears a brown bib-and-brace work overall over a white long-sleeve shirt, with the sleeves rolled up for practicality.

Under the instruction of the chief train engineer, Tatsu, along with seven other train maintenance workers, was tasked with preparing the Mugen Train for service after it was brought back to the maintenance facility due to suspicions of a demon linked to numerous disappearances.

In the train maintenance facility, Tatsu is resting in the office when Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku arrives in the main hall to bring the workers bento boxes with food. The chief engineer instructs a worker to deliver a box to the resting Tatsu. However, the Slasher demon has entered the building in search of new prey and finds Tatsu. The demon captures Tatsu, holding him hostage by his neck. When Kyojuro and the other workers arrive at the scene, Tatsu cries out to the chief. Seeing a Demon Slayer, the demon tortures the boy, puncturing his cheek with a clawed thumb and digging clawed fingers into his chest. Tatsu cries out in pain from the demon’s attack.

entities.name: Tecchin Tecchikawahara
entities.description:
Tecchin is an elderly man who is partially bald on the crown of his head, but has white, shoulder length hair. Despite his face being obscured by a hyottoko mask, he has noticeable wrinkles which can be seen from above his mask and along his neck. He is very short in stature, even admitting he is the smallest resident of the entire village.

Tecchin wears a diamond patterned kimono with a white juban underneath, and a black haori on top. His haori has the kanji for |chō}} on the back.

In the only time he's shown unmasked, he's shown to have squinty eyes and buck teeth. However, given their cartoonish appearance, it's unknown if these features were exaggerated for comedic effect or not.

Tecchin has the tendency to be very straight forward in regards to his thoughts, openly admitting to being the most esteemed person in the village and proving so when he boldly told Tanjiro to bow before him till his head touched the floor. However, despite his intimidating demeanor, he still acts in a civilized manner as seen when he called Tanjiro a "nice young man" and even offered him snacks during their first meeting. Tecchin's authority as chief is such that he is the only one to control the hot-blooded and brash Hotaru Haganezuka, despite the village residents' general dislike of the smith for his attitude and antics.

entities.name: Teiko Shinazugawa
entities.description:
Teiko was a girl of average height and light skin complexion. Her black hair was tied in a bow in the back and she had large almond-shaped purple eyes. She was very similar in appearance to her brother Sanemi.

She wore a mint green kimono lined with white waving stripes and tied with a lime green obi.

Teiko, like her siblings, was a caring and loving young child. She loved her mother dearly and cared for her wellbeing, shielding her eyes during one of her father's abusive outbursts because she could not stand to see the violence and staying up late to wait for her to come home when she was late.

When she woke up to find Sanemi and her mother was not home at night, she looked to Genya as comfort, warmly addressing her older brother.

entities.description:
The の|Odō no Oni}} was the first demon Tanjiro Kamado encountered that has taken a human's life.

The Temple Demon was a muscular demon of average height. He had pale, ash-gray skin with two green marks around both of his upper arms and legs, and shoulder-length, spiky dark-green hair parted at the middle of his forehead. He also possessed prominent fangs and sharp nails, attributes common to demons.

The Temple Demon was seen wearing a sleeveless, blue tunic with a dark-turquoise-and-white pattern outlining his exposed chest. He wore pale colored bracelets around his wrists and ankles.

After getting his head kicked off by Nezuko Kamado, the demon grew two muscular arms out of the sides of his head.

entities.name: Tenma Uzui
entities.description:
Tenma is a young man of athletic build with long, messy white hair, a pale skin complexion, and narrow eyes. His irises are fuschia. Overall, he bears a striking resemblance to his flamboyant predecessor.

Tenma seems to be a playful and attention-seeking person. In the news picture about his gold medal win, he is seen doing an akanbe (an eyelid pull), accompanied by sticking his tongue out, while holding his medal towards the camera. He is also noted to be rude, often flashing his middle finger and choking reporters. Yoshiteru Agatsuma implies that Tenma is able to get away with his behaviour due to his looks.

As the Agatsuma siblings make their way to school, Toko Agatsuma looks at a news article on her phone, which shows that Tenma had just won a gold medal in gymnastics for Japan. Toko is smitten by Tenma, but her brother, Yoshiteru, responded to her affection by noting that Tenma was rude and gives examples of his unruly behaviour. Toko defended Tenma, and Yoshiteru wondered aloud if one can get away with anything just because he was attractive.

entities.description:
Teruko has shoulder-length black hair parted back into two low pigtails tied with red bobble hair ties. Like her older brothers, she has amber/brown eyes with fair skin.

Throughout her appearance, Teruko wears a pale-pink kimono and a purple obi with a square pattern.

Not much is known about her personality. One can assume she is a brave, loving, and loyal sister as she and Shoichi decided to follow Kiyoshi to save him after he was kidnapped by a demon.

Teruko lived with her two brothers, Kiyoshi and Shoichi along with their family. When out walking during the night with her brothers, Kiyoshi was kidnapped by Kyogai. She and Shoichi followed the trail of blood left by Kiyoshi due to him sustaining a wound on his leg. They eventually ended up at the Tsuzumi Mansion where they waited in shock, unsure of what to do.

entities.name: Tetsudoji
entities.description:
Like all swordsmiths, Tetsudoji wore a Hyottoko mask to hide his face, and his mask was identifiable by its large, black, and blocky eyebrows. He wears an olive haori with lighter stripes, baggy dark-gray pants tied around above his ankles, and has his head wrapped in a black scarf.

While not much is known about Tetsudoji's personality it is likely that he is very loyal to his village, as although he does not personally fight for it, he and his fellow swordsmiths are first introduced holding various swords, likely to guard and protect them from the destruction currently plaguing the village. He's also shown to be compassionate, as when witnessing Tanjiro Kamado weeping when hugging his sister who he mistook for dead, he began to cry as well. However, he's shown to be a bit more impulsive, as when Tanjiro faints due to his injury, he incorrectly assumes that he died.

In the latter half of the attack on the Swordsmith Village, Tetsudoji, alongside two fellow swordsmiths: Tetsumotonaka and Tetsutani were hiding in a bush on the outskirts of the village guarding some swords. It's unknown if they had fled from the attacking demons, or were alerted by the bell warning to hide before any reached them. He wore a long dark green haori, baggy black pants tied above his ankles, white socks, and light gray slippers.

Tetsuido was a gentle, keen, and understanding man, being one of the few people including Kagaya Ubuyashiki to see past the stoic façade Muichiro Tokito put on. He knew his client was hiding his problems behind the brave face he was showing and urged him to prevent making his issues his alone to burden. He was proud to be the Mist Hashira's swordsmith and mentioned that he tears up seeing his blade being used.

Tetsuido was delegated as the first swordsmith for the Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito. Despite Muichiro's quiet and blunt demeanour, Tetsuido sensed that he was hiding something and urged the young boy to speak to someone, in the hope his problems and burdens didn't weigh on him alone.

entities.name: Tojuro Rengoku
entities.description:
Tojuro shares a striking resemblance with his ancestor, Senjuro and his brother Kyojuro. Like them, he also has golden shoulder length hair with red tips, black forked eyebrows and gold eyes with red irises.

Like Kyojuro, Tojuro has an air of great optimism, is extremely positive and often have an enthusiastic smile plastered on his face. He says thanks, even when insulted. He has a very strong heart.

He has a passion for kendō, often forgetting about everything else when he's training and participating in the kendō club at school.

On his way to school, Tojuro sees his friend Sumihiko Kamado running and catches up to him. Greeting him, Sumihiko remarks at how it is unusual for Tojuro to be late. Tojuro explains that he had woken up at 4 in the morning, but had gotten absorbed into his training. He says that he couldn't hear anything until his father whacked him. Suddenly a police car with two police officers, Sanehiro Shinazugawa and the reincarnation of Genya Shinazugawa, in it draws nearer to the boys, asking them to stop. but Tojuro ignores them and continues the conversation, telling Sumihiko that he should join a sports club at school. Sumihiko replies that it'd cut into his sleep, and Tojuro laughs and says that he should at least try something because he'd be awesome at it. Sumihiko says he could never hold a candle to Tojuro in terms of sport.

entities.name: Tokie
entities.description:
Tokie is a young girl with fair skin and a small, petite build. She has long straight black hair with four thin strands over her forehead and long bangs framing her face.

Tokie wore a lime-green kimono with a blue obi on the night of her kidnapping. She also wore a long, dark-red haori over her attire.

Tokie is shown to be a very prudent girl, as she obeyed her mother's request to stay home at night due to the series of disappearances during that period. She is also kind and caring, as shown when she wonders about whereabouts of the missing girls kidnapped by the Swamp Demon and hopes that they are alright.

Tokie is first seen leaving her family members to go to sleep, having just been told to stay indoors due to the disappearances that had been happening during the night. She obeys and sadly thinks about the girls who had already been kidnapped, hoping that no other girl would be taken as she gets into bed. As she's falling asleep, the Swamp Demon creates a swamp pool under her futon and pulls her under, much to her horror. She is defenseless to escape his grasp despite her struggling and is successfully knocked out and dragged into the depths.

entities.name: Toko Agatsuma
entities.description:
Toko bears a great resemblance to her ancestor, Nezuko Kamado, having the same waist-length black hair parted to the left side of her forehead, are closer to an actual red color than Nezuko's orange. She has round, pink eyes with prominent eyelashes and thin eyebrows.

Toko wears her school's standard uniform, consisting of a light blue long-sleeved shirt, black skirt, black ribbon necktie, and white vest. She also sports her uniform's black knee-socks and brown loafers.

Towards her younger brother, Toko shows great aggravation and animosity, often berating him for his antics and telling him off for not studying. At times, she resorts to physically attacking Yoshiteru, such as kicking his back or tugging on his ear. Such irritable behavior is similar to her great-grandfather. According to Yoshiteru, the females in their family were kind and gentle, with Toko being an exception. That said, her harsh actions show that she cares deeply about her younger brother's academic success and wants to see him grow up to be a mature and responsible individual, knowing Yoshiteru can do a good job if he tries. Through her efforts, Yoshiteru was able to improve his grades and gain admission to high school.

However, when Toko is with Kanata Kamado, she instantly loses her angry demeanor and instead becomes much more jubilant, especially if Kanata compliments her. She is still easily annoyed by her brother if he interrupts her and Kanata's activities.

entities.name: Tomi
entities.description:
Tomi was an old woman of short stature with long white hair worn in a bun down her back. She had dark purple eyes that fades into a violet color lower down. Her irises are white and horizontally rectangular.

Tomi wore a brown kimono and a red haori, as well as large round glasses.

Tomi was seen to be a polite and kind woman, evident when she defended Kyojuro Rengoku after her granddaughter became suspicious of him when he had asked her about demons. She cares for her granddaughter greatly and tried many times to reassure her when she was upset about the poor sales of her bentos at night.

Unlike most humans, Tomi has known about the existence of demons for a long time, owing to her own life almost ending to an attack years ago, which was the reasoning for her cautioning Fuku not to stay out at night, in spite of the girl's skepticism. She also was shown to be very brave, attacking the Slasher when he tried to attack her granddaughter.

entities.name: Tongue Demon
entities.description:
The |Shita oni}} was a demon that lived in the Tsuzumi Mansion.

The Tongue Demon was a muscular man with gray skin and very dark blue hair, set noticeably far back on his head to make room for the two small horns that protruded from either side of his forehead. He had two pairs of eyes, one large and cat-like of a green color and the other more squinted and set above the first, their irises red. His most notable features were his extremely long tongue and the navy blue arrows that patterned his nose and forearms, a large blotch of a similar color on each temple.

The Tongue Demon wore nothing above his waist, under which he sported only the bottom half of a patterned knee-length yukata.

The Tongue Demon, as with many others of his kind, was a ruthless being who seemed only to care about eating any and all humans that crossed his path. He appeared to be somewhat unintelligent, as he often talked to himself and repeated words when speaking as well as crawled around on the floor rather than walking. He was at least confident enough in his abilities to scuffle with Kyogai and a much larger demon over the right to eat a Marechi boy Kyogai kidnapped.

entities.description:
Toyo is a man of average height and build, with a bald head and eyes he usually keeps closed. He wears a dull yellow-and-black striped kimono, light pants, and dark shoes. In his first appearance, he was also smoking a kiseru.

Toyo is very passionate about his udon, as he was visibly agitated towards Tanjiro Kamado for discarding his bowl without eating any of it. However, once Tanjiro returned, ordered two more bowls, and gobbled them down, Toyo was pleased and thanked him for his business.

Toyo was born and raised in Asakusa. At some point in his life, he opened an udon handcart at the edge of Asakusa, as he loved the city and wanted to stay there.

During Tanjiro's second mission as a Demon Slayer, he was tasked with investigating a demonic presence in Asakusa. Overwhelmed and disoriented by his inexperience in modern cities, he quickly fled the busy, bustling center and stopped at an udon shop owned by Toyo. As he ordered an udon bowl and prepared to eat, he detected the scent that was present in his home that day when he'd found his family massacred. He stood up in shock, inadvertently causing his food to drop to the ground, and pursued the scent.

entities.name: Tsutako Tomioka
entities.description:
Tsutako was a dark-haired young woman with light skin. She wore her hair in a thick braid tied with a light-colored ribbon down her back and a loose fringe over her forehead. Her eyes were a shade of dark blue similar to her younger brother. For her attire, she wore a dark red kimono and a hakama that was tied below her chest.

While little is known about Tsutako, she appeared to have been a courageous and loving sister to Giyu Tomioka, evidenced by his guilt and sadness over her sacrifice. She loved her brother dearly enough to save him with her own life, even despite being set to wed the next day.

The day before her scheduled wedding, Tsutako sacrificed her life to protect her younger brother from a Demon. From then on, Giyu Tomioka expressed intense guilt for his sister's death to the point where he began thinking that dying would be better for him.

After Giyu Tomioka tells his story to Tanjiro Kamado, the young Demon Slayer questions him about how Sabito's words were keeping them together. After hearing this, Giyu thinks back to when Sabito slapped and berated him for making a negative statement about his life, something that would be considered an insult to his sister's memory, given that she sacrificed herself to protect him from demons the day before her wedding. Giyu realizes that his companions were still with him and internally apologizes to Sabito and Tsutako for his negative outlook.

entities.name: Ubume
entities.description:
Ubume was a petite woman whose long black hair was styled in a braided bun. She had blood-red eyes; her left eye had the kanji for |Ka}} and daiji for |Ichi}} etched into its iris, and her hair was adorned with crimson flower. Like most demons, her mouth showed prominent fangs.

When she was a human, Ubume was rumored to be a kind parental figure who cared immensely for her loved ones, especially her only daughter, Sae. However, these rumors belied the truth that she was a wicked and twisted person who cared only for her personal happiness, even if it came at the expense of others' well-being. Ubume displays a kind and compassionate disposition on the outside that masks her cruel, merciless, and unempathetic nature.

She felt immense ecstasy when she was nursing children in pain, her daughter included, and to maintain that feeling, she was even willing to go as far as to torture children and sabotage their recovery to continue nursing them. She showed great fury when defied, decrying any child who refused to play along with her whims as ungrateful and traitorous while painting herself as the one who was wronged, excusing her actions as displays of motherly compassion even despite the fact that she's the one who inflicted the suffering on others.

She was also shown to be hypocritical and ungrateful when one of her victims did show affection towards her. This is best exemplified when a young girl she had kidnapped pleaded with Masachika Kumeno to not hurt Ubume, causing him to become disoriented. Ubume tossed the girl aside and used the opportunity to land a fatal blow on the Demon Slayer, mockingly claiming that he should've cut down the child.

entities.name: Uraga
entities.description:
While not much is known about Uraga's appearance prior to his encounter with Ubume, his brutalized appearance is described as consisting of a crushed windpipe and an emaciated arm that was "as skinny as a twig". He also had blood-soaked bandages.

Sanemi described him as "strong and hearty"; he was shown to be someone who valued his girlfriend, as he showed concern for her even when heavily injured. Sanemi also remembered him stating a desire to start a family. However, Uraga was shown to have become fatalistic in his final moments, as when Ubume caused him to spasm, he believed escaping was hopeless and committed suicide.

Uraga did not get along with his parents, particularly his mother. At some point, Uraga entered and passed the same Final Selection as Sanemi Shinazugawa, leaving a decent impression on the young Demon Slayer who viewed him as strong and hearty, and opening up about his desire to start a family.

Later on, Uraga and another Demon Slayer were kidnapped by Ubume, the Lower Rank One of the Twelve Kizuki. They were brutalized and tortured by Ubume, so the demon could twistedly nurse them back to health. While his partner did not survive, Uraga barely clung to life. Sanemi encountered the heavily injured Uraga and his dead partner while he faced an illusion from Ubume's Blood Demon Art. Uraga vomited, causing Ubume to clean him and attempt to give the Demon Slayer water from a pitcher, although he was too weak to swallow. As Sanemi approached the demon, Uraga called for help, leading Sanemi to recognize him. Ubume became vexed and attempted to claw at Uraga's throat, but the Demon Slayer was saved by Sanemi.

entities.name: Uta
entities.description:
When Yoriichi Tsugikuni first met her, Uta was a small young girl with a pale complexion and large eyes that Yoriichi described to be similar to obsidian in color, that were framed by long eyelashes and small, wide eyebrows. She had straight, dark hair that reached just past her shoulders, worn tied with a ribbon in a loose ponytail down her back, with three shorter strands on either side of her face, one set reaching her ears, the second reaching her chin and the third over her shoulders.

She wore an orange-colored kimono with a dark green geometric design, pink flowers patterned in between, over which a white apron was tied from her waist down. She also sported a wrap of white cloth around the crown of her head.

Uta's appearance as an adult was similar, the only notable difference being that her hair was now almost waist-length and that her apron had been switched for a length of cloth that she tied around her waist in place of an obi.

thumb|200px|Uta and Yoriichi. In Yoriichi's flashbacks, Uta is initially seen as a very quiet and lonely girl due the fact she had lost her entire family at a young age. This was shown by the fact that she brought tadpoles from the rice field inside her barrel to eventually bring them home with her, but returned them back into the rice field out of empathy—she felt sorry for the tadpoles that had been seperated from their families just as she had. When Yoriichi offered to come home with her instead, she was so touched by his actions that she began to cry.
